root_node.definition: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow

catch (object).definition: anything that is caught (especially if it is worth catching)

charm.definition: something believed to bring good luck

amulet.definition: a trinket or piece of jewelry usually hung about the neck and thought to be a magical protection against evil or disease

juju.definition: a charm superstitiously believed to embody magical powers

commemorative.definition: an object (such as a coin or postage stamp) made to mark an event or honor a person

curio.definition: something unusual -- perhaps worthy of collecting

collectible.definition: things considered to be worth collecting (not necessarily valuable or antique)

collector's_item.definition: the outstanding item (the prize piece or main exhibit) in a collection

discard.definition: anything that is cast aside or discarded

draw (object).definition: anything (straws or pebbles etc.) taken or chosen at random

scum.definition: a film of impurities or vegetation that can form on the surface of a liquid

slag.definition: the scum formed by oxidation at the surface of molten metals

basic_slag.definition: slag produced in making steel; low in silica but having large amounts of calcium phosphate; useful as fertilizer

slick (film).definition: a film of oil or garbage floating on top of water

oil_slick.definition: a thin film of oil floating on top of water (especially crude oil spilled from a ship)

soap_film.definition: a film left on objects after they have been washed in soap

floater (object).definition: an object that floats or is capable of floating

fomite.definition: any inanimate object (as a towel or money or clothing or dishes or books or toys etc.) that can transmit infectious agents from one person to another

geological_formation.definition: (geology) the geological features of the earth

aquifer.definition: underground bed or layer yielding ground water for wells and springs etc

beach.definition: an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake

plage.definition: the beach at a seaside resort

cave.definition: a geological formation consisting of an underground enclosure with access from the surface of the ground or from the sea

cavern (cave).definition: a large cave or a large chamber in a cave

cove.definition: small or narrow cave in the side of a cliff or mountain

grotto.definition: a small cave (usually with attractive features)

cliff.definition: a steep high face of rock

crag.definition: a steep rugged rock or cliff

delta.definition: a low triangular area of alluvial deposits where a river divides before entering a larger body of water

diapir.definition: a domed rock formation where a core of rock has moved upward and pierced through the more brittle overlying strata

folium.definition: a thin layer or stratum of (especially metamorphic) rock

foreshore.definition: the part of the seashore between the highwater mark and the low-water mark

iceberg.definition: a large mass of ice floating at sea; usually broken off of a polar glacier

growler (iceberg).definition: a small iceberg or ice floe just large enough to be hazardous for shipping

glacier.definition: a slowly moving mass of ice

alpine_glacier.definition: a glacier that moves down from a high valley

continental_glacier.definition: a glacier that spreads out from a central mass of ice

polar_glacier.definition: a glacier near the Arctic or Antarctic poles

piedmont_glacier.definition: a type of glaciation characteristic of Alaska; large valley glaciers meet to form an almost stagnant sheet of ice

ice_field.definition: a large flat mass of ice (larger than an ice floe) floating at sea

ice_floe.definition: a flat mass of ice (smaller than an ice field) floating at sea

icecap.definition: a mass of ice and snow that permanently covers a large area of land (e.g., the polar regions or a mountain peak)

massif.definition: a block of the earth's crust bounded by faults and shifted to form peaks of a mountain range

monocline.definition: a geological formation in which all strata are inclined in the same direction

mouth (geological_formation).definition: the point where a stream issues into a larger body of water

natural_depression.definition: a sunken or depressed geological formation

cirque.definition: a steep-walled semicircular basin in a mountain; may contain a lake

tidal_basin.definition: a basin that is full of water at high tide

bed (natural_depression).definition: a depression forming the ground under a body of water

ocean_floor.definition: the bottom of a sea or ocean

abyssal_zone.definition: the deep sea (2000 meters or more) where there is no light

continental_shelf.definition: the relatively shallow (up to 200 meters) seabed surrounding a continent

continental_slope.definition: the steep descent of the seabed from the continental shelf to the abyssal zone

neritic_zone.definition: the ocean waters from the low tide mark to a depth of about 100 fathoms

twilight_zone.definition: the lowest level of the ocean to which light can reach

riverbed.definition: a channel occupied (or formerly occupied) by a river

streambed.definition: a channel occupied (or formerly occupied) by a stream

wash (streambed).definition: the dry bed of an intermittent stream (as at the bottom of a canyon)

crater.definition: a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb

collector (crater).definition: a crater that has collected cosmic material hitting the earth

lunar_crater.definition: a crater on the Earth's Moon

hole (natural_depression).definition: a depression hollowed out of solid matter

burrow.definition: a hole made by an animal, usually for shelter

warren (burrow).definition: a series of connected underground tunnels occupied by rabbits

gopher_hole.definition: a hole in the ground made by gophers

kettle_hole.definition: (geology) a hollow (typically filled by a lake) that results from the melting of a mass of ice trapped in glacial deposits

pit (hole).definition: a sizeable hole (usually in the ground)

borrow_pit.definition: a pit created to provide earth that can be used as fill at another site

divot (pit).definition: (golf) the cavity left when a piece of turf is cut from the ground by the club head in making a stroke

fire_pit.definition: a pit whose floor is incandescent lava

quicksand.definition: a pit filled with loose wet sand into which objects are sucked down

sandpit.definition: a large pit in sandy ground from which sand is dug

sawpit.definition: a pit over which lumber is positioned to be sawed by two men with a long two-handed saw

tar_pit.definition: a natural accumulation of bitumens at the surface of the earth; often acts as a trap for animals whose bones are thus preserved

trou-de-loup.definition: a sloping pit with a stake in the middle used as an obstacle to the enemy

pothole.definition: a pit or hole produced by wear or weathering (especially in a road surface)

rabbit_burrow.definition: a hole in the ground as a nest made by wild rabbits

wormhole.definition: hole made by a burrowing worm

landfill.definition: a low area that has been filled in

sanitary_landfill.definition: a low area where waste is buried between layers of earth

sinkhole.definition: a depression in the ground communicating with a subterranean passage (especially in limestone) and formed by solution or by collapse of a cavern roof

trench.definition: a long steep-sided depression in the ocean floor

trough (natural_depression).definition: a narrow depression (as in the earth or between ocean waves or in the ocean bed)

swale.definition: a low area (especially a marshy area between ridges)

valley.definition: a long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river

dale.definition: an open river valley (in a hilly area)

glen.definition: a narrow secluded valley (in the mountains)

gully.definition: deep ditch cut by running water (especially after a prolonged downpour)

draw (gully).definition: a gully that is shallower than a ravine

wadi.definition: gully or streambed in northern Africa and the Middle East that remains dry except during rainy season

nullah.definition: a ravine or gully in southern Asia

ravine.definition: a deep narrow steep-sided valley (especially one formed by running water)

canyon.definition: a ravine formed by a river in an area with little rainfall

gorge.definition: a deep ravine (usually with a river running through it)

gulch.definition: a narrow gorge with a stream running through it

rift_valley.definition: a valley with steep sides; formed by a rift in the earth's crust

natural_elevation.definition: a raised or elevated geological formation

down (highland).definition: (usually plural) a rolling treeless highland with little soil

terrace.definition: a level shelf of land interrupting a declivity (with steep slopes above and below)

hill.definition: a local and well-defined elevation of the land

butte.definition: a hill that rises abruptly from the surrounding region; has a flat top and sloping sides

foothill.definition: a relatively low hill on the lower slope of a mountain

anthill.definition: a mound of earth made by ants as they dig their nest

kopje.definition: a small hill rising up from the African veld

molehill.definition: a mound of earth made by moles while burrowing

mountain.definition: a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill

seamount.definition: an underwater mountain rising above the ocean floor

guyot.definition: a seamount of volcanic origin (especially in the Pacific Ocean)

volcano.definition: a mountain formed by volcanic material

promontory.definition: a natural elevation (especially a rocky one that juts out into the sea)

mull.definition: a term used in Scottish names of promontories

point (promontory).definition: a promontory extending out into a large body of water

ridge (natural_elevation).definition: a long narrow natural elevation or striation

bluff.definition: a high steep bank (usually formed by river erosion)

sandbank.definition: a submerged bank of sand near a shore or in a river; can be exposed at low tide

shoal.definition: a sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide

dune.definition: a ridge of sand created by the wind; found in deserts or near lakes and oceans

seif_dune.definition: a long and tall sand dune with a sharp crest; common in the Sahara

esker.definition: (geology) a long winding ridge of post glacial gravel and other sediment; deposited by meltwater from glaciers or ice sheets

ledge.definition: a projecting ridge on a mountain or submerged under water

berm.definition: a narrow ledge or shelf typically at the top or bottom of a slope

atoll.definition: an island consisting of a circular coral reef surrounding a lagoon

barrier_reef.definition: a long coral reef near and parallel to the shore

key (coral_reef).definition: a coral reef off the southern coast of Florida

ripple_mark.definition: one of a series of small ridges produced in sand by water currents or by wind

swell.definition: a rounded elevation (especially one on an ocean floor)

range (geological_formation).definition: a series of hills or mountains

relict (geological_formation).definition: geological feature that is a remnant of a pre-existing formation after other parts have disappeared

arete.definition: a sharp narrow ridge found in rugged mountains

shore (geological_formation).definition: the land along the edge of a body of water

seashore.definition: the shore of a sea or ocean

landfall.definition: the seacoast first sighted on a voyage (or flight over water)

littoral.definition: the region of the shore of a lake or sea or ocean

seaside.definition: the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort

tideland.definition: land near the sea that is overflowed by the tide

strand (shore).definition: a poetic term for a shore (as the area periodically covered and uncovered by the tides)

ascent.definition: an upward slope or grade (as in a road)

uphill.definition: the upward slope of a hill

waterside.definition: land bordering a body of water

canyonside.definition: the steeply sloping side of a canyon

coast.definition: a slope down which sleds may coast

downhill.definition: the downward slope of a hill

steep.definition: a steep place (as on a hill)

escarpment (slope).definition: a long steep slope or cliff at the edge of a plateau or ridge; usually formed by erosion

hillside.definition: the side or slope of a hill

mountainside.definition: the side or slope of a mountain

piedmont.definition: a gentle slope leading from the base of a mountain to a region of flat land

spring (geological_formation).definition: a natural flow of ground water

fountain_of_youth.definition: a fountain described in folk tales as able to make people young again

geyser.definition: a spring that discharges hot water and steam

hot_spring.definition: a natural spring of water at a temperature of 70 F or above

talus.definition: a sloping mass of loose rocks at the base of a cliff

vein (geological_formation).definition: a layer of ore between layers of rock

bonanza.definition: an especially rich vein of precious ore

volcanic_crater.definition: a bowl-shaped geological formation at the top of a volcano

caldera.definition: a large crater caused by the violent explosion of a volcano that collapses into a depression

maar.definition: a flat-bottomed volcanic crater that was formed by an explosion; often filled with water

wall (geological_formation).definition: a vertical (or almost vertical) smooth rock face (as of a cave or mountain)

water_table.definition: underground surface below which the ground is wholly saturated with water

hail.definition: many objects thrown forcefully through the air

hoodoo (object).definition: something believed to bring bad luck

ice (object).definition: the frozen part of a body of water

drift_ice.definition: masses of ice floating in the open sea

icefall.definition: a steep part of a glacier resembling a frozen waterfall

neve.definition: the upper part of a glacier (beyond the limit of perpetual snow) where the snow turns to ice

pack_ice.definition: a large expanse of floating ice

shelf_ice.definition: ice that is attached to land but projects out to sea

love-token.definition: keepsake given as a token of love

party_favor.definition: souvenir consisting of a small gift given to a guest at a party

cracker (party_favor).definition: a party favor consisting of a paper roll (usually containing candy or a small favor) that pops when pulled at both ends

bottomland.definition: low-lying alluvial land near a river

cultivated_land.definition: arable land that is worked by plowing and sowing and raising crops

fallow.definition: cultivated land that is not seeded for one or more growing seasons

overburden.definition: the surface soil that must be moved away to get at coal seams and mineral deposits

polder.definition: low-lying land that has been reclaimed and is protected by dikes (especially in the Netherlands)

turf (land).definition: surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots

divot (turf).definition: a piece of turf dug out of a lawn or fairway (by an animals hooves or a golf club)

wetland.definition: a low area where the land is saturated with water

mire.definition: a soft wet area of low-lying land that sinks underfoot

marsh.definition: low-lying wet land with grassy vegetation; usually is a transition zone between land and water

salt_marsh.definition: low-lying wet land that is frequently flooded with saltwater

swamp.definition: low land that is seasonally flooded; has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog

slough (swamp).definition: a stagnant swamp (especially as part of a bayou)

archipelago.definition: a group of many islands in a large body of water

beachfront.definition: a strip of land running along a beach

cape (land).definition: a strip of land projecting into a body of water

spit (cape).definition: a narrow strip of land that juts out into the sea

coastal_plain.definition: a plain adjacent to a coast

tidewater.definition: low-lying coastal land drained by tidal streams

floor (land).definition: the ground on which people and animals move about

foreland.definition: land forming the forward margin of something

forest.definition: land that is covered with trees and shrubs

riparian_forest.definition: woodlands along the banks of stream or river

silva.definition: the forest trees growing in a country or region

tree_farm.definition: a forest (or part of a forest) where trees are grown for commercial use

pinetum.definition: an area planted with pine trees or related conifers

island (land).definition: a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water

aegean_island.definition: an island in the Aegean Sea

barrier_island.definition: a long narrow sandy island (wider than a reef) running parallel to the shore

caribbean_island.definition: an island in the Caribbean Sea

south_sea_islands.definition: any islands in the southern or southwestern of central parts of the Pacific Ocean

isthmus.definition: a relatively narrow strip of land (with water on both sides) connecting two larger land areas

landmass.definition: a large continuous extent of land

continent.definition: one of the large landmasses of the earth

mainland.definition: the main land mass of a country or continent; as distinguished from an island or peninsula

neck (land).definition: a narrow elongated projecting strip of land

oxbow (land).definition: the land inside an oxbow bend in a river

peninsula.definition: a large mass of land projecting into a body of water

plain.definition: extensive tract of level open land

alluvial_flat.definition: a flat resulting from repeated deposits of alluvial material by running water

salt_flat.definition: a flat expanse of salt left by the evaporation of a body of salt water

floodplain.definition: a low plain adjacent to a river that is formed chiefly of river sediment and is subject to flooding

llano.definition: an extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)

moor (plain).definition: open land usually with peaty soil covered with heather and bracken and moss

peneplain.definition: a more or less level land surface representing an advanced stage of erosion undisturbed by crustal movements

snowfield.definition: a permanent wide expanse of snow

steppe.definition: extensive plain without trees (associated with eastern Russia and Siberia)

tundra.definition: a vast treeless plain in the Arctic regions where the subsoil is permanently frozen

slash.definition: an open tract of land in a forest that is strewn with debris from logging (or fire or wind)

wonderland.definition: a place or scene of great or strange beauty or wonder

location (object).definition: a point or extent in space

base (location).definition: the place where you are stationed and from which missions start and end

bilocation.definition: the ability (said of certain Roman Catholic saints) to exist simultaneously in two locations

earth.definition: the abode of mortals (as contrasted with Heaven or Hell)

east.definition: a location in the eastern part of a country, region, or city

home (location).definition: the country or state or city where you live

jungle.definition: a location marked by an intense competition and struggle for survival

concrete_jungle.definition: an area in a city with large modern buildings that is perceived as dangerous and unpleasant

line (location).definition: a spatial location defined by a real or imaginary unidimensional extent

aclinic_line.definition: an imaginary line paralleling the equator where a magnetic needle has no dip

agonic_line.definition: an imaginary line connecting points on the Earth's surface where the magnetic declination is zero

axis (line).definition: a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions

coordinate_axis.definition: one of the fixed reference lines of a coordinate system

x-axis.definition: the horizontal axis in a plane coordinate system

y-axis.definition: the vertical axis in a plane coordinate system

z-axis.definition: the third axis in a 3-dimensional coordinate system

major_axis.definition: the longest axis of an ellipse or ellipsoid; passes through the two foci

minor_axis.definition: the shorter or shortest axis of an ellipse or ellipsoid

optic_axis.definition: in a doubly refracting crystal, the line in the direction of which no double refraction occurs

principal_axis.definition: a line that passes through the center of curvature of a lens so that light is neither reflected nor refracted

semimajor_axis.definition: one-half the major axis of an ellipse; the distance from the center of an ellipse to one end

semiminor_axis.definition: one-half the minor axis of an ellipse

crest (line).definition: the top line of a hill, mountain, or wave

danger_line.definition: a line beyond which it is dangerous to go

fault_line.definition: (geology) line determined by the intersection of a geological fault and the earth's surface

flight_line.definition: place where airplanes are parked and the maintenance hangars (but not the runways or taxiways)

great_circle.definition: a circular line on the surface of a sphere formed by intersecting it with a plane passing through the center

celestial_equator.definition: the great circle on the celestial sphere midway between the celestial poles

hour_circle.definition: a great circle on the celestial sphere that passes through both celestial poles

magnetic_meridian.definition: an imaginary line passing through both magnetic poles of the Earth

observer's_meridian.definition: a meridian that passes through the observer's zenith

prime_meridian.definition: meridian at zero degree longitude from which east and west are reckoned (usually the Greenwich longitude in England)

vertical_circle.definition: a great circle on the celestial sphere passing through the zenith and perpendicular to the horizon

hemline.definition: the line formed by the lower edge of a skirt or coat

horizon (line).definition: the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet

isogonic_line.definition: an imaginary line connecting points on the Earth's surface where the magnetic declination is the same

isogram.definition: a line drawn on a map connecting points having the same numerical value of some variable

isobar.definition: (meteorology)an isogram connecting points having equal barometric pressure at a given time

isochrone.definition: an isogram connecting points at which something occurs or arrives at the same time

isoclinic_line.definition: an isogram connecting points of equal magnetic inclination

isohel.definition: an isogram connecting points receiving equal amounts of sunshine

isotherm.definition: (meteorology) an isogram connecting points having the same temperature at a given time

latitude (line).definition: an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator

horse_latitude.definition: either of two belts or regions near 30 degrees north or 30 degrees south; characterized by calms and light-baffling winds

polar_circle.definition: a line of latitude at the north or south poles

tropic.definition: either of two parallels of latitude about 23.5 degrees to the north and south of the equator representing the points farthest north and south at which the sun can shine directly overhead and constituting the boundaries of the Torrid Zone or tropics

line_of_force.definition: an imaginary line in a field of force; direction of the line at any point is the direction of the force at that point

electrical_line_of_force.definition: a line of force in an electrical field

magnetic_line_of_force.definition: a line of force in a magnetic field

line_of_sight.definition: an imaginary straight line along which an observer looks

lunar_latitude.definition: an imaginary line around the moon parallel to its equator

part (line).definition: a line of scalp that can be seen when sections of hair are combed in opposite directions

air_lane.definition: a designated route followed by airplanes in flying from one airport to another

approach_path.definition: the final path followed by an aircraft as it is landing

holding_pattern.definition: the flight path (usually circular) maintained by an aircraft that is awaiting permission to land

beat.definition: a regular route for a sentry or policeman

bus_route.definition: the route regularly followed by a passenger bus

circuit (path).definition: an established itinerary of venues or events that a particular group of people travel to

direction.definition: a line leading to a place or point

bearing (direction).definition: the direction or path along which something moves or along which it lies

tack (bearing).definition: the heading or position of a vessel relative to the trim of its sails

east-west_direction.definition: in a direction parallel with lines of latitude

north-south_direction.definition: in a direction parallel with lines of longitude

qibla.definition: the direction of the Kaaba toward which Muslims turn for their daily prayers

tendency.definition: a general direction in which something tends to move

feeder_line.definition: a branching path off of a main transportation line (especially an airline)

flight_path.definition: the path of a rocket or projectile or aircraft through the air

line_of_fire.definition: the path of a missile discharged from a firearm

line_of_flight.definition: the path along which a freely moving object travels through the air

line_of_march.definition: the route along which a column advances

main_line.definition: the principal route of a transportation system

migration_route.definition: the geographic route along which birds customarily migrate

paper_route.definition: the route taken when delivering newspapers every day

supply_line.definition: a route over which supplies can be delivered

track (path).definition: (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data

trade_route.definition: a route followed by traders (usually in caravans)

traffic_pattern.definition: the path that is prescribed for an airplane that is preparing to land at an airport

collision_course.definition: a course of a moving object that will lead to a collision if it continues unchanged

inside_track.definition: the inner side of a curved racecourse

round (path).definition: the course along which communications spread

steps.definition: the course along which a person has walked or is walking in

swath (path).definition: a path or strip (as cut by one course of mowing)

trail (path).definition: a track or mark left by something that has passed

slot (trail).definition: the trail of an animal (especially a deer)

spoor.definition: the trail left by a person or an animal; what the hunter follows in pursuing game

quadrant (line).definition: a quarter of the circumference of a circle

rhumb_line.definition: a line on a sphere that cuts all meridians at the same angle; the path taken by a ship or plane that maintains a constant compass direction

side (line).definition: a line segment forming part of the perimeter of a plane figure

snow_line.definition: the line on a mountain above which there is perpetual snow and ice

timber_line.definition: line marking the upper limit of tree growth in mountains or northern latitudes

water_line.definition: a line marking the level reached by a body of water

high-water_mark.definition: a line marking the highest level reached

low-water_mark.definition: a line marking the lowest level reached

waterline.definition: a line corresponding to the surface of the water when the vessel is afloat on an even keel; often painted on the hull of a ship

load_line.definition: waterlines to show the level the water should reach when the ship is properly loaded

watershed.definition: a ridge of land that separates two adjacent river systems

continental_divide.definition: the watershed of a continent (especially the watershed of North America formed by a series of mountain ridges extending from Alaska to Mexico)

north.definition: a location in the northern part of a country, region, or city

northeast.definition: a location in the northeastern part of a country, region, or city

northwest.definition: a location in the northwestern part of a country, region, or city

outer_space.definition: any location outside the Earth's atmosphere

pass.definition: the location in a range of mountains of a geological formation that is lower than the surrounding peaks

water_gap.definition: a pass in a mountain ridge through which a stream flows

wind_gap.definition: a pass in a mountain ridge with no stream flowing through it

defile.definition: a narrow pass (especially one between mountains)

saddleback.definition: a pass or ridge that slopes gently between two peaks (is shaped like a saddle)

point (location).definition: the precise location of something; a spatially limited location

abutment (point).definition: point of contact between two objects or parts

antinode.definition: (physics) the point of maximum displacement in a periodic system

beginning.definition: the place where something begins, where it springs into being

birthplace (beginning).definition: where something originated or was nurtured in its early existence

derivation.definition: the source or origin from which something derives (i.e. comes or issues)

home (beginning).definition: place where something began and flourished

jumping-off_place.definition: a place from which an enterprise or expedition is launched

point_source.definition: a concentrated source (especially of radiation or pollution) that is spatially constricted

spring (beginning).definition: a point at which water issues forth

wellhead (beginning).definition: the source of water for a well

blind_spot.definition: the point where the optic nerve enters the retina; not sensitive to light

celestial_point.definition: a point in the heavens (on the celestial sphere)

antapex.definition: the point opposite in direction from the solar apex; the point the solar system is moving away from

apex.definition: the point on the celestial sphere toward which the sun and solar system appear to be moving relative to the fixed stars

apoapsis.definition: (astronomy) the point in an orbit farthest from the body being orbited

aposelene.definition: apoapsis in orbit around the moon

culmination.definition: (astronomy) a heavenly body's highest celestial point above an observer's horizon

vernal_equinox.definition: (astronomy) the equinoctial point that lies in the constellation of Pisces

exaltation.definition: the location of a planet in the zodiac at which it is believed to exert its maximum influence

node (celestial_point).definition: (astronomy) a point where an orbit crosses a plane

ascending_node.definition: the point at which an orbit crosses the ecliptic plane going north

round_robin.definition: a letter signed by a number of people

drawing.definition: a representation of forms or objects on a surface by means of lines

charcoal (drawing).definition: a drawing made with a stick of black carbon material

delineation.definition: a drawing of the outlines of forms or objects

animalization.definition: a depiction in the form of an animal

diagram.definition: a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts

block_diagram.definition: a diagram showing the interconnections between the components of system (especially an electronic system)

horoscope.definition: a diagram of the positions of the planets and signs of the zodiac at a particular time and place

schematic.definition: diagram of an electrical or mechanical system

wiring_diagram.definition: a schematic drawing of the wiring of an electrical system

mechanical_drawing.definition: scale drawing of a machine or architectural plan etc,

vertical_section.definition: a mechanical drawing showing the interior of an object as if made by a vertical plane passing through it

pen-and-ink.definition: a drawing executed with pen and ink

elevation.definition: drawing of an exterior of a structure

ground_plan.definition: a floor plan for the ground level of a building

rendering (drawing).definition: perspective drawing of an architect's design

silhouette (drawing).definition: a drawing of the outline of an object; filled in with some uniform color

silverpoint.definition: a drawing made on specially prepared paper with an instrument having a silver tip (15th and 16th centuries)

design (sketch).definition: a preliminary sketch indicating the plan for something

draft (sketch).definition: a preliminary sketch of a design or picture

vignette (sketch).definition: a small illustrative sketch (as sometimes placed at the beginning of chapters in books)

stick_figure.definition: drawing of a human or animal that represents the head by a circle and the rest of the body by straight lines

tracing.definition: a drawing created by superimposing a semitransparent sheet of paper on the original image and copying on it the lines of the original image

ecce_homo.definition: a representation (a picture or sculpture) of Jesus wearing a crown of thorns

effigy.definition: a representation of a person (especially in the form of sculpture)

idol (effigy).definition: a material effigy that is worshipped

joss.definition: a Chinese god worshipped in the form of an idol

scarecrow.definition: an effigy in the shape of a man to frighten birds away from seeds

waxwork.definition: an effigy (usually of a famous person) made of wax

illustration.definition: a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand

plate (illustration).definition: a full-page illustration (usually on slick paper)

fashion_plate.definition: a plate illustrating the latest fashion in dress

map.definition: a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

chart.definition: a map designed to assist navigation by air or sea

naval_chart.definition: a chart for a navigator showing the prevailing meteorological and hydrographic and navigational conditions

contour_map.definition: a map having contour lines through points of equal elevation

plat.definition: a map showing planned or actual features of an area (streets and building lots etc.)

road_map.definition: a map showing roads (for automobile travel)

sketch_map.definition: a map drawn from observation (rather than from exact measurements) and representing the main features of an area

weather_map.definition: (meteorology) a map showing the principal meteorological elements at a given time and over an extended region

wind_rose.definition: weather map showing the frequency and strength of winds from different directions

model (representation).definition: representation of something (sometimes on a smaller scale)

figure.definition: a model of a bodily form (especially of a person)

dummy (figure).definition: a figure representing the human form

lay_figure.definition: dummy in the form of an artist's jointed model of the human body

mannequin (dummy).definition: a life-size dummy used to display clothes

ventriloquist's_dummy.definition: a wooden dummy into which a ventriloquist projects the voice

figurehead.definition: figure on the bow of some sailing vessels

figurine.definition: a small carved or molded figure

puppet (figure).definition: a small figure of a person operated from above with strings by a puppeteer

snowman.definition: a figure of a person made of packed snow

mock-up.definition: full-scale working model of something built for study or testing or display

planetarium (model).definition: an apparatus or model for representing the solar systems

restoration (model).definition: a model that represents the landscape of a former geological age or that represents and extinct animal etc.

nomogram.definition: a graphic representation of numerical relations

objectification.definition: a concrete representation of an abstract idea or principle

photograph.definition: a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material

photocopy.definition: a photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work

photostat (photocopy).definition: a photocopy made on a Photostat machine

beefcake.definition: a photograph of a muscular man in minimal attire

blueprint.definition: photographic print of plans or technical drawings etc.

cheesecake.definition: a photograph of an attractive woman in minimal attire

closeup.definition: a photograph taken at close range

enlargement.definition: a photographic print that has been enlarged

frame.definition: a single one of a series of still transparent pictures forming a cinema, television or video film

glossy.definition: a photograph that is printed on smooth shiny paper

headshot.definition: a photograph of a person's head

hologram.definition: the intermediate photograph (or photographic record) that contains information for reproducing a three-dimensional image by holography

longshot.definition: a photograph taken from a distance

microdot.definition: photograph reduced to the size of a dot (usually for purposes of security)

mosaic (photograph).definition: arrangement of aerial photographs forming a composite picture

mug_shot.definition: a photograph of someone's face (especially one made for police records)

photographic_print.definition: a printed picture produced from a photographic negative

cutout (photographic_print).definition: a photograph from which the background has been cut away

standee (cutout).definition: a lifesize cardboard cutout (usually of a celebrity)

proof (photographic_print).definition: a trial photographic print from a negative

photomicrograph.definition: a photograph taken with the help of a microscope

autoradiograph.definition: a radiogram produced by radiation emitted by the specimen being photographed

roentgenogram.definition: a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis

angiogram.definition: an X-ray representation of blood vessels made after the injection of a radiopaque substance

lymphangiogram.definition: an angiogram of the lymph nodes and lymph vessels made after the injection of a radiopaque substance

arteriogram.definition: an X ray of an artery filled with a contrast medium

arthrogram.definition: an X ray of a joint after the injection of a contrast medium

encephalogram.definition: an X ray of the brain made by replacing spinal fluid with a gas (usually oxygen) to improve contrast

mammogram.definition: X-ray film of the soft tissue of the breast

myelogram.definition: X-ray film of the spinal cord and spinal nerve roots and subarachnoid space

pyelogram.definition: an X ray of the kidneys and ureters

intravenous_pyelogram.definition: X-ray picture of the kidneys and ureters after injection of a radiopaque dye

venogram.definition: an X ray of a vein injected with a radiopaque contrast medium

scene (photograph).definition: a consecutive series of pictures that constitutes a unit of action in a film

outtake.definition: a scene that is filmed but is not used in the final editing of the film

snapshot.definition: an informal photograph; usually made with a small hand-held camera

spectrogram.definition: a photographic record of a spectrum

visible_speech.definition: spectrogram of speech; speech displayed spectrographically

stereo (photograph).definition: two photographs taken from slightly different angles that appear three-dimensional when viewed together

anaglyph (stereo).definition: moving or still pictures in contrasting colors that appear three-dimensional when superimposed

still (photograph).definition: a static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes)

radiophotograph.definition: a photograph transmitted by radio waves

time_exposure.definition: a photograph produced with a relatively long exposure time

vignette (photograph).definition: a photograph whose edges shade off gradually

wedding_picture.definition: photographs of bride and groom and their friends taken at their wedding

picture.definition: a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface

collage.definition: a paste-up made by sticking together pieces of paper or photographs to form an artistic image

photomontage.definition: a montage that uses photographic images

slide (foil).definition: a transparency mounted in a frame; viewed with a slide projector

viewgraph.definition: a transparency for use with an overhead projector

graphic.definition: an image that is generated by a computer

iconography.definition: the images and symbolic representations that are traditionally associated with a person or a subject

inset.definition: a small picture inserted within the bounds or a larger one

likeness.definition: picture consisting of a graphic image of a person or thing

portrait.definition: any likeness of a person, in any medium

half-length.definition: a portrait showing the body from only the waist up

self-portrait.definition: a portrait of yourself created by yourself

panorama.definition: a picture (or series of pictures) representing a continuous scene

reflection.definition: the image of something as reflected by a mirror (or other reflective material)

pieta.definition: a representation of the Virgin Mary mourning over the dead body of Jesus

shade (representation).definition: a representation of the effect of shadows in a picture or drawing (as by shading or darker pigment)

backdrop.definition: scenery hung at back of stage

coulisse (flat).definition: a flat situated in the wings

tormenter.definition: a flat at each side of the stage to prevent the audience from seeing into the wings

set_piece.definition: a piece of scenery intended to stand alone as part of the stage setting

station_of_the_cross.definition: a representation of any of the 14 stages in Christ's journey to Calvary

decker.definition: (often used in combinations) something constructed with multiple levels

adornment.definition: a decoration of color or interest that is added to relieve plainness

band (adornment).definition: an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material

hatband.definition: a band around the crown of a hat just above the brim

neckband.definition: a band around the collar of a garment

pinstripe (band).definition: a very thin stripe (especially a white stripe on a dark fabric)

beauty_spot.definition: a spot that is worn on a lady's face for adornment

boutonniere.definition: a flower that is worn in a buttonhole

circlet.definition: decorated metal band worn around the head

cordon.definition: adornment consisting of an ornamental ribbon or cord

epaulet.definition: adornment consisting of an ornamental cloth pad worn on the shoulder

fob (adornment).definition: an adornment that hangs from a watch chain

frill.definition: a strip of pleated material used as a decoration or a trim

goffer (frill).definition: an ornamental frill made by pressing pleats

jabot.definition: a ruffle on the front of a woman's blouse or a man's shirt

peplum.definition: a flared ruffle attached to the waistline of a dress or jacket or blouse

frog (adornment).definition: a decorative loop of braid or cord

frontlet.definition: an adornment worn on the forehead

jewelry.definition: an adornment (as a bracelet or ring or necklace) made of precious metals and set with gems (or imitation gems)

bead.definition: a small ball with a hole through the middle

bugle (bead).definition: a tubular glass or plastic bead sewn onto clothing for decoration

bijou.definition: a small and delicately worked piece

bracelet.definition: jewelry worn around the wrist for decoration

anklet (bracelet).definition: an ornament worn around the ankle

armilla.definition: (archeology) a bracelet worn around the wrist or arm

clip (jewelry).definition: an article of jewelry that can be clipped onto a hat or dress

earring.definition: jewelry to ornament the ear; usually clipped to the earlobe or fastened through a hole in the lobe

pendant_earring.definition: an earring with a pendant ornament

jewel (jewelry).definition: a precious or semiprecious stone incorporated into a piece of jewelry

crown_jewel.definition: a precious stone that is a valuable part of a sovereign's regalia

diamond.definition: a transparent piece of diamond that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem

emerald.definition: a transparent piece of emerald that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem

pearl.definition: a smooth lustrous round structure inside the shell of a clam or oyster; much valued as a jewel

ruby.definition: a transparent piece of ruby that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem

sapphire.definition: a transparent piece of sapphire that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem

solitaire (jewel).definition: a gem (usually a diamond) in a setting by itself

necklace.definition: jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women)

pin (jewelry).definition: a piece of jewelry that is pinned onto the wearer's garment

brooch.definition: a decorative pin worn by women

sunburst (brooch).definition: a jeweled brooch with a pattern resembling the sun

scatter_pin.definition: small pin usually worn in groups of two or more

stickpin.definition: a decorative pin that is worn in a necktie

tie_tack.definition: a pin used to hold the tie in place

ring (jewelry).definition: jewelry consisting of a circlet of precious metal (often set with jewels) worn on the finger

engagement_ring.definition: a ring given and worn as a sign of betrothal

mourning_ring.definition: a ring worn as a memorial to a dead person

wedding_ring.definition: a ring (usually plain gold) given to the bride (and sometimes one is also given to the groom) at the wedding

tie_clip.definition: a piece of jewelry that holds a man's tie in place

pectoral.definition: an adornment worn on the chest or breast

pendant.definition: an adornment that hangs from a piece of jewelry (necklace or earring)

lavaliere.definition: jeweled pendant worn on a chain around the neck

plume.definition: a feather or cluster of feathers worn as an ornament

panache.definition: a feathered plume on a helmet

sequin.definition: adornment consisting of a small piece of shiny material used to decorate clothing

aglet (braid).definition: ornamental tagged cord or braid on the shoulder of a uniform

miniver.definition: trimming on ceremonial robes consisting of white or light grey fur

rickrack.definition: a narrow zigzag ribbon used as trimming

war_paint (adornment).definition: adornment consisting of paint applied to the face and body of certain Amerindians before a battle

arabesque.definition: an ornament that interlaces simulated foliage in an intricate design

guilloche.definition: an architectural decoration formed by two intersecting wavy bands

trefoil.definition: an architectural ornament in the form of three arcs arranged in a circle

brass (decoration).definition: an ornament or utensil made of brass

centerpiece.definition: something placed at the center of something else (as on a table)

epergne.definition: a large table centerpiece with branching holders for fruit or sweets or flowers

christmas_tree.definition: an ornamented evergreen used as a Christmas decoration

cockade.definition: an ornament (such as a knot of ribbon or a rosette) usually worn on the hat

damascene (design).definition: a design produced by inlaying gold or silver into steel

device (design).definition: any ornamental pattern or design (as in embroidery)

bulla.definition: the round leaden seal affixed to a papal bull

great_seal.definition: the principal seal of a government, symbolizing authority or sovereignty

handstamp.definition: a stamp (usually made of rubber) for imprinting a mark or design by hand

signet.definition: a seal (especially one used to mark documents officially)

emblem.definition: special design or visual object representing a quality, type, group, etc.

colophon.definition: a publisher's emblem printed in a book (usually on the title page)

crest (emblem).definition: (heraldry) in medieval times, an emblem used to decorate a helmet

calvary_cross.definition: a Latin cross set on three steps

celtic_cross.definition: a Latin cross with a ring surrounding the intersection

crucifix.definition: representation of the cross on which Jesus died

jerusalem_cross.definition: a cross with equal arms, each terminating in a small crossbar

latin_cross.definition: a cross with the lowest arm being longer than the others

lorraine_cross.definition: a cross with two crossbars, one above and one below the midpoint of the vertical, the lower longer than the upper

maltese_cross.definition: a cross with triangular or arrow-shaped arms and the points toward the center

st._andrew's_cross.definition: a cross resembling the letter x, with diagonal bars of equal length

tau_cross.definition: cross resembling the Greek letter tau

union.definition: a device on a national flag emblematic of the union of two or more sovereignties (typically in the upper inner corner)

flag (emblem).definition: emblem usually consisting of a rectangular piece of cloth of distinctive design

american_flag.definition: the national flag of the United States of America

banner.definition: long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising

battle_flag.definition: a flag that leads troops into battle

black_flag.definition: a flag usually bearing a white skull and crossbones on a black background; indicates a pirate ship

colors (flag).definition: a flag that shows its nationality

ensign (colors).definition: colors flown by a ship to show its nationality

fanion.definition: a small flag used by surveyors or soldiers to mark a position

jack (flag).definition: small flag indicating a ship's nationality

national_flag.definition: an emblem flown as a symbol of nationality

pennoncel.definition: a small pennant borne on a lance

oriflamme.definition: a red or orange-red flag used as a standard by early French kings

stars_and_bars.definition: the first flag of the Confederate States of America

tricolor.definition: a flag having three colored stripes (especially the French flag)

union_jack.definition: national flag of the United Kingdom

white_flag.definition: flag consisting of a piece of white cloth that is hoisted to signal surrender or to ask for a truce

yellow_jack (flag).definition: yellow flag hoist on a ship in quarantine

heraldry.definition: emblem indicating the right of a person to bear arms

annulet (charge).definition: (heraldry) a charge in the shape of a circle

fleur-de-lis.definition: (heraldry) charge consisting of a conventionalized representation of an iris

ordinary (charge).definition: (heraldry) any of several conventional figures used on shields

bar_sinister.definition: a mark of bastardy; lines from top right to bottom left

fesse.definition: (heraldry) an ordinary consisting of a broad horizontal band across a shield

coat_of_arms.definition: the official symbols of a family, state, etc.

skull_and_crossbones.definition: emblem warning of danger or death

totem.definition: emblem consisting of an object such as an animal or plant; serves as the symbol of a family or clan (especially among American Indians)

linocut (design).definition: a design carved in relief into a block of linoleum

mandala.definition: any of various geometric designs (usually circular) symbolizing the universe; used chiefly in Hinduism and Buddhism as an aid to meditation

crisscross.definition: a marking that consists of lines that cross each other

eyespot.definition: an eyelike marking (as on the wings of some butterflies); usually a spot of color inside a ring of another color

shading.definition: graded markings that indicate light or shaded areas in a drawing or painting

hatch (shading).definition: shading consisting of multiple crossing lines

spot (marking).definition: a small contrasting part of something

macule.definition: a patch of skin that is discolored but not usually elevated; caused by various diseases

freckle.definition: a small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin

liver_spot.definition: a type of skin disease that causes brown spots on the skin

plague_spot.definition: a spot on the skin characteristic of the plague

nebula.definition: (pathology) a faint cloudy spot on the cornea

parhelion.definition: a bright spot on the parhelic circle; caused by diffraction by ice crystals

plaque.definition: (pathology) a small abnormal patch on or inside the body

arterial_plaque.definition: a fatty deposit inside an arterial wall; characteristic of atherosclerosis

sunspot.definition: a cooler darker spot appearing periodically on the sun's photosphere; associated with a strong magnetic field

worn_spot.definition: a spot that has been worn away by abrasion or erosion

stripe.definition: a narrow marking of a different color or texture from the background

band (stripe).definition: a stripe or stripes of contrasting color

collar (band).definition: (zoology) an encircling band or marking around the neck of any animal

stretch_mark.definition: a narrow band resulting from tension on the skin (as on abdominal skin after pregnancy)

motif.definition: a design or figure that consists of recurring shapes or colors, as in architecture or decoration

polka_dot.definition: design consisting of a pattern of regularly spaced circular spots

screen_saver.definition: (computer science) a moving design that appears on a computer screen when there has been no input for a specified period of time

sunburst (design).definition: a design consisting of a central disk resembling the sun and rays emanating from it

tattoo.definition: a design on the skin made by tattooing

tetraskelion.definition: a figure consisting of four stylized human arms or legs (or bent lines) radiating from a center

swastika.definition: the official emblem of the Nazi Party and the Third Reich; a cross with the arms bent at right angles in a clockwise direction

triskelion.definition: a figure consisting of three stylized human arms or legs (or three bent lines) radiating from a center

houndstooth_check.definition: textile with a pattern of small broken or jagged checks

twill (weave).definition: a weave used to produce the effect of parallel diagonal ribs

vermiculation.definition: a decoration consisting of wormlike carvings

boulle.definition: an inlaid furniture decoration; tortoiseshell and yellow and white metal form scrolls in cabinetwork

filigree.definition: delicate and intricate ornamentation (usually in gold or silver or other fine twisted wire)

paraph.definition: a flourish added after or under your signature (originally to protect against forgery)

bouquet.definition: an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present

flower_chain.definition: flowers strung together in a chain

festoon (flower_chain).definition: flower chains suspended in curves between points as a decoration

spray.definition: flower arrangement consisting of a single branch or shoot bearing flowers and foliage

wreath.definition: flower arrangement consisting of a circular band of foliage or flowers for ornamental purposes

folderal.definition: ornamental objects of no great value

topping.definition: a flavorful addition on top of a dish
