hand_blower.definition: a hand-held electric blower that can blow warm air onto the hair; used for styling hair

bellows.definition: a mechanical device that blows a strong current of air; used to make a fire burn more fiercely or to sound a musical instrument

bootjack.definition: has V-shaped notch for pulling off boots

breathalyzer.definition: a device that measures chemicals (especially the alcohol content) in a person's expired breath

breathing_device.definition: a device that facilitates breathing in cases of respiratory failure

aqualung.definition: a device (trade name Aqua-Lung) that lets divers breathe under water; scuba is an acronym for self-contained underwater breathing apparatus

oxygen_mask.definition: a breathing device that is placed over the mouth and nose; supplies oxygen from an attached storage tank

respirator.definition: a breathing device for administering long-term artificial respiration

iron_lung.definition: respirator that produces alternations in air pressure in a chamber surrounding a patient's chest to force air into and out of the lungs thus providing artificial respiration

resuscitator.definition: a breathing apparatus used for resuscitation by forcing oxygen into the lungs of a person who has undergone asphyxia or arrest of respiration

snorkel (breathing_device).definition: breathing device consisting of a bent tube fitting into a swimmer's mouth and extending above the surface; allows swimmer to breathe while face down in the water

bubbler.definition: any of various devices in which air or some other gas is bubbled through a liquid

buffer (device).definition: a cushion-like device that reduces shock due to an impact

catapult (device).definition: a device that launches aircraft from a warship

charger (device).definition: a device for charging or recharging batteries

clip-on.definition: a device (as an earring, sunglasses, microphone etc.) that is attached by clips

comb (device).definition: a flat device with narrow pointed teeth on one edge; disentangles or arranges hair

currycomb.definition: a square comb with rows of small teeth; used to curry horses

fine-tooth_comb.definition: a comb with teeth set close together

pocketcomb.definition: a small comb suitable for carrying in a pocket

comforter.definition: device used for an infant to suck or bite on

conductor (device).definition: a device designed to transmit electricity, heat, etc.

busbar.definition: an electrical conductor that makes a common connection between several circuits

cable (conductor).definition: a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power

coaxial_cable.definition: a transmission line for high-frequency signals

ethernet_cable.definition: any of several types of coaxial cable used in ethernets

electrical_cable.definition: a cable that provides an electrical connection for telephone or television or power stations

fiber_optic_cable.definition: a cable made of optical fibers that can transmit large amounts of information at the speed of light

printer_cable.definition: a cable between a computer and a printer

cord (conductor).definition: a light insulated conductor for household use

extension_cord.definition: an electric cord used to extend the length of a power cord

power_cord.definition: a cord to conduct power to an electrical appliance

electrode.definition: a conductor used to make electrical contact with some part of a circuit

anode (electrode).definition: a positively charged electrode by which electrons leave an electrical device

plate (anode).definition: the positively charged electrode in a vacuum tube

base (electrode).definition: (electronics) the part of a transistor that separates the emitter from the collector

cathode (electrode).definition: a negatively charged electrode that is the source of electrons entering an electrical device

cold_cathode.definition: a cathode that is a source of electrons without being heated

photocathode.definition: a cathode that emits electrons when illuminated

collector (electrode).definition: the electrode in a transistor through which a primary flow of carriers leaves the region between the electrodes

electron_gun.definition: the electrode that is the source of electrons in a cathode-ray tube or electron microscope; consists of a cathode that emits a stream of electrons and the electrostatic or electromagnetic apparatus that focuses it

emitter.definition: the electrode in a transistor where electrons originate

grid (electrode).definition: an electrode placed between the cathode and anode of a vacuum tube to control the flow of electrons through the tube

heat_sink.definition: a metal conductor specially designed to conduct (and radiate) heat

lightning_rod (conductor).definition: a metallic conductor that is attached to a high point and leads to the ground; protects the building from destruction by lightning

semiconductor_device.definition: a conductor made with semiconducting material

chip (semiconductor_device).definition: electronic equipment consisting of a small crystal of a silicon semiconductor fabricated to carry out a number of electronic functions in an integrated circuit

biochip.definition: a microchip that uses tiny strands of DNA to latch onto and quickly recognize thousands of genes at a time; intended for use in a biological environment

gene_chip.definition: a microchip that holds DNA probes that form half of the DNA double helix and can recognize DNA from samples being tested

memory_chip.definition: a RAM microchip that can be plugged into a computer to provide additional memory

read-only_memory_chip.definition: a memory chip providing read-only memory

microprocessor.definition: integrated circuit semiconductor chip that performs the bulk of the processing and controls the parts of a system

diode (semiconductor_device).definition: a semiconductor that consists of a p-n junction

light-emitting_diode.definition: diode such that light emitted at a p-n junction is proportional to the bias current; color depends on the material used

organic_light-emitting_diode.definition: a self-luminous diode (it glows when an electrical field is applied to the electrodes) that does not require backlighting or diffusers

n-type_semiconductor.definition: a semiconductor in which electrical conduction is due chiefly to the movement of electrons

p-type_semiconductor.definition: a semiconductor in which electrical conduction is due chiefly to the movement of positive holes

thermistor.definition: a semiconductor device made of materials whose resistance varies as a function of temperature; can be used to compensate for temperature variation in other components of a circuit

transistor.definition: a semiconductor device capable of amplification

field-effect_transistor.definition: a transistor in which most current flows in a channel whose effective resistance can be controlled by a transverse electric field

p-n-p_transistor.definition: a junction transistor having an n-type semiconductor between a p-type semiconductor that serves as an emitter and a p-type semiconductor that serves as a collector

shunt (conductor).definition: a conductor having low resistance in parallel with another device to divert a fraction of the current

waveguide.definition: a hollow metal conductor that provides a path to guide microwaves; used in radar

wire (conductor).definition: a metal conductor that carries electricity over a distance

jumper_cable.definition: a jumper that consists of a short piece of wire

clip_lead.definition: a short piece of wire with alligator clips on both ends

filament (wire).definition: a thin wire (usually tungsten) that is heated white hot by the passage of an electric current

lead-in.definition: wire connecting an antenna to a receiver or a transmitter to a transmission line

patchcord.definition: a length of wire that has a plug at each end; used to make connections at a patchboard

telephone_wire.definition: the wire that carries telegraph and telephone signals

telephone_cord.definition: the telephone wire that connects to the handset

contraceptive.definition: an agent or device intended to prevent conception

cervical_cap.definition: a contraceptive device consisting of a small thimble-shaped cup that is placed over the uterine cervix to prevent the entrance of spermatozoa

coil (contraceptive).definition: a contraceptive device placed inside a woman's womb

condom.definition: contraceptive device consisting of a sheath of thin rubber or latex that is worn over the penis during intercourse

diaphragm (contraceptive).definition: a contraceptive device consisting of a flexible dome-shaped cup made of rubber or plastic; it is filled with spermicide and fitted over the uterine cervix

intrauterine_device.definition: contraceptive device consisting of a piece of bent plastic or metal that is inserted through the vagina into the uterus

loop.definition: an intrauterine device in the shape of a loop

morning-after_pill.definition: a large dose of estrogen taken orally within 24 to 72 hours after intercourse; prevents implantation of a fertilized ovum and so acts as a contraceptive; commonly used after rape or incest

pill (contraceptive).definition: a contraceptive in the form of a pill containing estrogen and progestin to inhibit ovulation and so prevent conception

demulen.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive

enovid.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing mestranol and norethynodrel

lo/ovral.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norgestrel

loestrin.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norethindrone

micronor.definition: trade name for and oral contraceptive containing the progestin compound norethindrone

modicon.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norethindrone

nor-q-d.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing norethindrone

norinyl.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing norethindrone and mestranol

norlestrin.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norethindrone

ovocon.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norethindrone

ovral.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norgestrel

ovrette.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing norgestrel

ovulen.definition: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing mestranol and a progestin compound

spermicide.definition: a contraceptive agent that kills spermatozoa

converter.definition: a device for changing one substance or form or state into another

bessemer_converter.definition: a refractory-lined furnace used to convert pig iron into steel by the Bessemer process

catalytic_converter.definition: a converter that uses a platinum-iridium catalyst to oxidize pollutants and carbon monoxide into carbon dioxide and water; an antipollution device on an automotive exhaust system

data_converter.definition: converter for changing information from one code to another

digital-analog_converter.definition: device for converting digital signals into analogue signals

digitizer.definition: device for converting analogue signals into digital signals

electrical_converter.definition: converter that converts alternating current into direct current or vice versa

inverter.definition: an electrical converter that converts direct current into alternating current

power_pack.definition: a device for converting a power supply to a voltage required by particular equipment

synchronous_converter.definition: electrical converter consisting of a synchronous machine that converts alternating to direct current or vice versa

electronic_converter.definition: (telecommunication) converter for converting a signal from one frequency to another

torque_converter.definition: converter for transmitting and amplifying torque (especially by hydraulic means)

corer.definition: a device for removing the core from apples

corrective.definition: a device for treating injury or disease

prosthesis.definition: corrective consisting of a replacement for a part of the body

glass_eye.definition: prosthesis consisting of an artificial eye made of glass

implant.definition: a prosthesis placed permanently in tissue

artificial_heart.definition: a pump that replaces the natural heart

jarvik_heart.definition: a kind of artificial heart that has been used with some success

artificial_joint.definition: a metal or plastic part that is surgically implanted to replace a natural joint (possibly elbow or wrist but usually hip or knee)

breast_implant.definition: an implant for cosmetic purposes to replace a breast that has been surgically removed

dental_implant.definition: an implant that replaces a natural tooth

heart_valve.definition: an implant that replaces a natural cardiac valve

lens_implant.definition: a clear plastic lens that is implanted in the eye; usually done when the natural lens has been removed in a cataract operation

accommodating_lens_implant.definition: a lens implant containing a hinge that allows for both near and far vision (thus mimicking the natural lens of a young person)

monofocal_lens_implant.definition: a lens with a single focus that is used after cataract surgery to provide clear distance vision

multifocal_lens_implant.definition: a type of lens implant that contains several rings with a common center and adjusts for near or far vision; the eye is in focus for near and far vision simultaneously

penile_implant.definition: an implant that creates an artificial erection

shunt (implant).definition: implant consisting of a tube made of plastic or rubber; for draining fluids within the body

obturator.definition: a prosthesis used to close an opening (as to close an opening of the hard palate in cases of cleft palate)

peg (prosthesis).definition: a prosthesis that replaces a missing leg

cryptograph.definition: a device for deciphering codes and ciphers

cutoff.definition: a device that terminates the flow in a pipe

dampener.definition: a device that dampens or moistens something

damper (device).definition: a device that decreases the amplitude of electronic, mechanical, acoustical, or aerodynamic oscillations

damper_block.definition: damper consisting of a small felted block that drops onto a piano string to stop its vibration

dash-pot.definition: a mechanical damper; the vibrating part is attached to a piston that moves in a chamber filled with liquid

shock_absorber.definition: a mechanical damper; absorbs energy of sudden impulses

air_cushion (shock_absorber).definition: a mechanical device using confined air to absorb the shock of motion

deflector.definition: a device intended to turn aside the flow of something (water or air or smoke etc)

dental_appliance.definition: a device to repair teeth or replace missing teeth

bite_plate.definition: a removable dental appliance that is worn in the palate for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes

brace (dental_appliance).definition: an appliance that corrects dental irregularities

crown (dental_appliance).definition: (dentistry) dental appliance consisting of an artificial crown for a broken or decayed tooth

denture.definition: a dental appliance that artificially replaces missing teeth

bridge (denture).definition: a denture anchored to teeth on either side of missing teeth

partial_denture.definition: a denture replacing one or more teeth in a dental arch

filling.definition: (dentistry) a dental appliance consisting of any of various substances (as metal or plastic) inserted into a prepared cavity in a tooth

inlay (filling).definition: (dentistry) a filling consisting of a solid substance (as gold or porcelain) fitted to a cavity in a tooth and cemented into place

retainer.definition: a dental appliance that holds teeth (or a prosthesis) in position after orthodontic treatment

depressor.definition: a device used by physician to press a part down or aside

tongue_depressor.definition: a thin depressor used to press the tongue down during an examination of the mouth and throat

detector (device).definition: any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner

metal_detector.definition: detector that gives a signal when it detects the presence of metal; used to detect the presence of stray bits of metal in food products or to find buried metal

mine_detector.definition: detector consisting of an electromagnetic device; used to locate explosive mines

trace_detector.definition: a screening device for traces of explosives; used at airline terminals

diestock.definition: a device that holds the dies that cut external threads on metal cylinders

drive (device).definition: (computer science) a device that writes data onto or reads data from a storage medium

cd-rom_drive.definition: a drive that is connected to a computer and on which a CD-ROM can be `played'

cd_drive.definition: a drive that reads a compact disc and that is connected to an audio system

disk_drive.definition: computer hardware that holds and spins a magnetic or optical disk and reads and writes information on it

external_drive.definition: a drive with its own power supply and fan mounted outside the computer system enclosure and connected to the computer by a cable

internal_drive.definition: a drive mounted inside of a computer

ram_disk.definition: (computer science) a virtual drive that is created by setting aside part of the random-access memory to use as if it were a group of sectors

elastic_device.definition: any flexible device that will return to its original shape when stretched

spring (elastic_device).definition: a metal elastic device that returns to its shape or position when pushed or pulled or pressed

bedspring.definition: (usually plural) one of the springs holding up the mattress of a bed

box_spring.definition: a coiled bedspring in a frame that is covered with cloth

coil_spring.definition: a spring in the shape of a coil

leaf_spring.definition: long narrow spring consisting of several layers of metal springs bracketed together

mainspring.definition: the most important spring in a mechanical device (especially a clock or watch); as it uncoils it drives the mechanism

spiral_spring.definition: a spring that is wound like a spiral

hairspring.definition: a fine spiral spring that regulates the movement of the balance wheel in a timepiece

electrical_device.definition: a device that produces or is powered by electricity

antenna.definition: an electrical device that sends or receives radio or television signals

dipole.definition: an aerial half a wavelength long consisting of two rods connected to a transmission line at the center

directional_antenna.definition: an antenna that transmits or receives signals only in a narrow angle

array (directional_antenna).definition: an arrangement of aerials spaced to give desired directional characteristics

dish (directional_antenna).definition: directional antenna consisting of a parabolic reflector for microwave or radio frequency radiation

scanner (dish).definition: a radar dish that rotates or oscillates in order to scan a broad area

omnidirectional_antenna.definition: an antenna that sends or receives signals equally in all directions

radio_antenna.definition: omnidirectional antenna comprising the part of a radio receiver by means of which radio signals are received

television_antenna.definition: an omnidirectional antenna tuned to the broadcast frequencies assigned to television

rabbit_ears (television_antenna).definition: an indoor TV antenna; consists of two extendible rods that form a V

attenuator.definition: an electrical device for attenuating the strength of an electrical signal

ballast.definition: an electrical device for starting and regulating fluorescent and discharge lamps

battery (electrical_device).definition: a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series

a_battery.definition: the battery used to heat the filaments of a vacuum tube

b_battery.definition: battery for supplying a constant positive voltage to the plate of a vacuum tube

c_battery.definition: battery used to maintain the grid potential in a vacuum tube

voltaic_battery.definition: battery consisting of a number of voltaic cells arranged in series or parallel

dry_battery.definition: a voltaic battery consisting of two or more dry cells

flashlight_battery.definition: a small dry battery containing dry cells; used to power flashlights

storage_battery.definition: a voltaic battery that stores electric charge

lead-acid_battery.definition: a battery with lead electrodes with dilute sulphuric acid as the electrolyte; each cell generates about 2 volts

car_battery.definition: a lead-acid storage battery in a motor vehicle; usually a 12-volt battery of six cells; the heart of the car's electrical system

nicad.definition: a rechargeable battery with a nickel cathode and a cadmium anode; often used in emergency systems because of its low discharge rate when not in use

nickel-iron_battery.definition: a storage battery having a nickel oxide cathode and an iron anode with an electrolyte of potassium hydroxide; each cell gives about 1.2 volts

voltaic_pile.definition: battery consisting of voltaic cells arranged in series; the earliest electric battery devised by Volta

bimetallic_strip.definition: a strip consisting of two metals that bends with a rise in temperature

brush (electrical_device).definition: conducts current between rotating and stationary parts of a generator or motor

capacitor.definition: an electrical device characterized by its capacity to store an electric charge

bypass_condenser.definition: a capacitor that provides low impedance over certain (high) frequencies

electrolytic.definition: a fixed capacitor consisting of two electrodes separated by an electrolyte

leiden_jar.definition: an electrostatic capacitor of historical interest

trimmer (capacitor).definition: capacitor having variable capacitance; used for making fine adjustments

cell (electrical_device).definition: a device that delivers an electric current as the result of a chemical reaction

electrolytic_cell.definition: a cell containing an electrolyte in which an applied voltage causes a reaction to occur that would not occur otherwise (such as the breakdown of water into hydrogen and oxygen)

fuel_cell.definition: cell that produces electricity by oxidation of fuel (hydrogen and oxygen or zinc and air); often used in electric cars

solar_cell.definition: a cell that converts solar energy into electrical energy

storage_cell.definition: a cell that can be recharged

voltaic_cell.definition: an electric cell that generates an electromotive force by an irreversible conversion of chemical to electrical energy; cannot be recharged

leclanche_cell.definition: voltaic cell that produces approximately 1.5 volts

dry_cell.definition: a small Leclanche cell containing no free liquid; the electrolyte is a paste and the negative zinc pole forms the container of the cell; used in flashlights, portable radios, etc.

mercury_cell.definition: a primary cell consisting of a zinc anode and a cathode of mercury oxide and an electrolyte of potassium hydroxide

standard_cell.definition: a primary cell used as a standard of electromotive force

clark_cell.definition: a form of voltaic cell once used as a standard for electromotive force

wet_cell.definition: a primary voltaic cell having a liquid electrolyte

circuit (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow

bridge (circuit).definition: a circuit consisting of two branches (4 arms arranged in a diamond configuration) across which a meter is connected

wheatstone_bridge.definition: a bridge used to measure resistances

bridged-t.definition: a circuit consisting of a T-network with an additional shunt bridging the two series circuits

closed_circuit.definition: a complete electrical circuit around which current flows or a signal circulates

parallel_circuit.definition: a closed circuit in which the current divides into two or more paths before recombining to complete the circuit

computer_circuit.definition: a circuit that is part of a computer

gate (computer_circuit).definition: a computer circuit with several inputs but only one output that can be activated by particular combinations of inputs

and_circuit.definition: a circuit in a computer that fires only when all of its inputs fire

nand_circuit.definition: a logic gate that produces an output that is the inverse of the output of an AND gate

or_circuit.definition: a gate circuit in a computer that fires when any of its inputs fire

x-or_circuit.definition: gate for exclusive OR; a circuit in a computer that fires only if only one of its inputs fire

integrated_circuit.definition: a microelectronic computer circuit incorporated into a chip or semiconductor; a whole system rather than a single component

interface (computer_circuit).definition: (computer science) computer circuit consisting of the hardware and associated circuitry that links one device with another (especially a computer and a hard disk drive or other peripherals)

parallel_interface.definition: an interface between a computer and a printer where the computer sends multiple bits of information to the printer simultaneously

serial_port.definition: an interface (commonly used for modems and mice and some printers) that transmits data a bit at a time

small_computer_system_interface.definition: interface consisting of a standard port between a computer and its peripherals that is used in some computers

module (computer_circuit).definition: computer circuit consisting of an assembly of electronic components (as of computer hardware)

printed_circuit.definition: computer circuit consisting of an electronic sub-assembly; copper conductors are laminated on an insulating board or card and circuit components are inserted into holes and dip soldered

circuit_board.definition: a printed circuit that can be inserted into expansion slots in a computer to increase the computer's capabilities

cpu_board.definition: the main circuit board for a computer

pc_board.definition: a removable circuit board for a personal computer; fits into a slot in the mother board

delay_line.definition: a circuit designed to introduce a calculated delay into the transmission of a signal

acoustic_delay_line.definition: a delay line based on the time of propagation of sound waves

electromagnetic_delay_line.definition: a delay line based on the time of propagation of electromagnetic waves

feedback_circuit.definition: a circuit that feeds back some of the output to the input of a system

control_circuit.definition: a feedback circuit that subtracts from the input

flip-flop (circuit).definition: an electronic circuit that can assume either of two stable states

limiter.definition: (electronics) a nonlinear electronic circuit whose output is limited in amplitude; used to limit the instantaneous amplitude of a waveform (to clip off the peaks of a waveform)

link (circuit).definition: an interconnecting circuit between two or more locations for the purpose of transmitting and receiving data

open_circuit.definition: an incomplete electrical circuit in which no current flows

resonator (circuit).definition: an electrical circuit that combines capacitance and inductance in such a way that a periodic electric oscillation will reach maximum amplitude

series_circuit.definition: a circuit having its parts connected serially

squelch_circuit.definition: an electric circuit that cuts off a receiver when the signal becomes weaker than the noise

t-network.definition: a circuit formed by two equal series circuits with a shunt between them

wiring.definition: a circuit of wires for the distribution of electricity

light_circuit.definition: wiring that provides power to electric lights

control_panel.definition: electrical device consisting of a flat insulated surface that contains switches and dials and meters for controlling other electrical devices

dashboard.definition: instrument panel on an automobile or airplane containing dials and controls

distributor (electrical_device).definition: electrical device that distributes voltage to the spark plugs of a gasoline engine in the order of the firing sequence

electrograph (electrical_device).definition: electrical device used for etching by electrolytic means

electrostatic_generator.definition: electrical device that produces a high voltage by building up a charge of static electricity

electrophorus.definition: a simple electrostatic generator that generates repeated charges of static electricity

filter (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device that alters the frequency spectrum of signals passing through it

high-pass_filter.definition: a filter that passes frequencies above a certain value and attenuates frequencies below that value

low-pass_filter.definition: a filter that passes frequencies below a certain value and attenuates frequencies above that value

flasher.definition: an electrical device that automatically turns a lamp on and off (as for an advertising display)

fuse (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device that can interrupt the flow of electrical current when it is overloaded

cartridge_fuse.definition: a fuse cased in a tube

circuit_breaker.definition: a device that trips like a switch and opens the circuit when overloaded

plug_fuse.definition: a fuse with a thread that screws into a socket

inductor.definition: an electrical device (typically a conducting coil) that introduces inductance into a circuit

jack (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device consisting of a connector socket designed for the insertion of a plug

telephone_jack.definition: a jack for plugging in a telephone

load (electrical_device).definition: electrical device to which electrical power is delivered

plug (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device with two or three pins that is inserted in a socket to make an electrical connection

telephone_plug.definition: a plug for connecting a telephone

precipitator.definition: removes dust particles from gases by electrostatic precipitation

reactor.definition: an electrical device used to introduce reactance into a circuit

coil (reactor).definition: reactor consisting of a spiral of insulated wire that introduces inductance into a circuit

armature.definition: coil in which voltage is induced by motion through a magnetic field

rotor (armature).definition: the rotating armature of a motor or generator

astatic_coils.definition: an arrangement of coils used in sensitive electrical instruments; the coils are arranged to give zero resultant external magnetic field when a current passes through them and to have zero electromotive force induced in them by an external magnetic field

choke (coil).definition: a coil of low resistance and high inductance used in electrical circuits to pass direct current and attenuate alternating current

field_coil.definition: the electric coil around a field magnet that produces the magneto motive force to set up the flux in an electric machine

induction_coil.definition: a coil for producing a high voltage from a low-voltage source

ignition_coil.definition: an induction coil that converts current from a battery into the high-voltage current required by spark plugs

spark_coil.definition: an induction coil used to create sparks

primary_coil.definition: coil forming the part of an electrical circuit such that changing current in it induces a current in a neighboring circuit

read/write_head.definition: (computer science) a tiny electromagnetic coil and metal pole used to write and read magnetic patterns on a disk

secondary_coil.definition: coil such that current is induced in it by passing a current through the primary coil

tickler_coil.definition: a small coil in series with the anode of a vacuum tube and coupled to the grid to provide feedback

rectifier (electrical_device).definition: electrical device that transforms alternating into direct current

detector (rectifier).definition: rectifier that extracts modulation from a radio carrier wave

full-wave_rectifier.definition: rectifier that converts the negative half wave of an alternating current into a positive half wave

relay.definition: electrical device such that current flowing through it in one circuit can switch on and off a current in a second circuit

resistor.definition: an electrical device that resists the flow of electrical current

ballast_resistor.definition: a resistor inserted into a circuit to compensate for changes (as those arising from temperature fluctuations)

potential_divider.definition: resistors connected in series across a voltage source; used to obtain a desired fraction of the voltage

potentiometer (potential_divider).definition: a resistor with three terminals, the third being an adjustable center terminal; used to adjust voltages in radios and TV sets

dimmer.definition: a rheostat that varies the current through an electric light in order to control the level of illumination

security_system (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device that sets off an alarm when someone tries to break in

segway.definition: (trademark) a self-balancing personal transportation device with two wheels; can operate in any level pedestrian environment

solar_array.definition: electrical device consisting of a large array of connected solar cells

spark_arrester (electrical_device).definition: electrical device to reduce sparking when electrical contacts are opened or closed

spark_plug.definition: electrical device that fits into the cylinder head of an internal-combustion engine and ignites the gas by means of an electric spark

suppressor (electrical_device).definition: an electrical device for suppressing unwanted currents

surge_suppressor.definition: electrical device inserted in a power line to protect equipment from sudden fluctuations in current

transducer.definition: an electrical device that converts one form of energy into another

photoelectric_cell.definition: a transducer used to detect and measure light and other radiations

selenium_cell.definition: a photoelectric cell that uses a strip of selenium

electro-acoustic_transducer.definition: a transducer that converts electrical to acoustic energy or vice versa

cartridge (electro-acoustic_transducer).definition: an electro-acoustic transducer that is the part of the arm of a record player that holds the needle and that is removable

crystal_pickup.definition: a cartridge in which an output voltage is produced by the vibration of a piezoelectric crystal

earphone.definition: electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear

earplug (earphone).definition: an earphone that is inserted into the ear canal

telephone_receiver.definition: earphone that converts electrical signals into sounds

headset.definition: receiver consisting of a pair of headphones

loudspeaker.definition: electro-acoustic transducer that converts electrical signals into sounds loud enough to be heard at a distance

bullhorn.definition: a portable loudspeaker with built-in microphone and amplifier

squawk_box.definition: the loudspeaker on an intercom or public address system

subwoofer.definition: a loudspeaker that is designed to reproduce very low bass frequencies

tweeter.definition: a loudspeaker that reproduces higher audio frequency sounds

woofer.definition: a loudspeaker that reproduces lower audio frequency sounds

microphone.definition: device for converting sound waves into electrical energy

bug (microphone).definition: a small hidden microphone; for listening secretly

condenser_microphone.definition: microphone consisting of a capacitor with one plate fixed and the other forming the diaphragm moved by sound waves

crystal_microphone.definition: a microphone in which sound waves vibrate a piezoelectric crystal that generates a varying voltage

directional_microphone.definition: a microphone that is designed to receive sound from a particular direction

cardioid_microphone.definition: a directional microphone with a cardioid pattern of sensitivity

spike_mike.definition: a contact microphone for listening through walls

mosaic (transducer).definition: transducer formed by the light-sensitive surface on a television camera tube

transformer.definition: an electrical device by which alternating current of one voltage is changed to another voltage

coil (transformer).definition: a transformer that supplies high voltage to spark plugs in a gasoline engine

cascade_transformer.definition: a number of transformers in series; provides a high-voltage source

tesla_coil.definition: a step-up transformer with an air core; used to produce high voltages at high frequencies

voltage_regulator.definition: a transformer whose voltage ratio of transformation can be adjusted

transponder.definition: electrical device designed to receive a specific signal and automatically transmit a specific reply

zapper.definition: an electrical device that can injure or kill by means of electric currents

electronic_device.definition: a device that accomplishes its purpose electronically

answering_machine.definition: an electronic device that answers the telephone and records messages

beeper.definition: an electronic device that generates a series of beeps when the person carrying it is being paged

defibrillator.definition: an electronic device that administers an electric shock of preset voltage to the heart through the chest wall in an attempt to restore the normal rhythm of the heart during ventricular fibrillation

display (electronic_device).definition: an electronic device that represents information in visual form

caller_id.definition: a small display that will show you the telephone number of the party calling you

digital_display.definition: a display that gives the information in the form of characters (numbers or letters)

liquid_crystal_display.definition: a digital display that uses liquid crystal cells that change reflectivity in an applied electric field; used for portable computer displays and watches etc.

active_matrix_screen.definition: a type of LCD screen used for some portable computers; there is a separate circuit for each pixel

passive_matrix_display.definition: a type of LCD display used for some portable computers; parallel wires run both vertically and horizontally and pixels are turned on when the wires intersecting at that pixel are both energized

dual_scan_display.definition: a type of passive matrix display in which the top and bottom half of the screen are refreshed simultaneously

display_panel.definition: a vertical surface on which information can be displayed to public view

big_board.definition: the large display board at the New York Stock Exchange that reports on stocks traded on the exchange

flat_panel_display.definition: a type of video display that is thin and flat; commonly used in laptop computers

monitor (display).definition: display produced by a device that takes signals and displays them on a television screen or a computer monitor

computer_monitor.definition: a device that displays signals on a computer screen

screen (display).definition: the display that is electronically created on the surface of the large end of a cathode-ray tube

background.definition: (computer science) the area of the screen in graphical user interfaces against which icons and windows appear

computer_screen.definition: a screen used to display the output of a computer to the user

touch_screen.definition: a computer display that enables the user to interact with the computer by touching areas on the screen

window (display).definition: (computer science) a rectangular part of a computer screen that contains a display different from the rest of the screen

dialog_box.definition: (computer science) a small temporary window in a graphical user interface that appears in order to request information from the user; after the information has been provided the user dismisses the box with `okay' or `cancel'

foreground.definition: (computer science) a window for an active application

display_adapter.definition: (computer science) an electronic device that converts information in memory to video output to a display

dongle.definition: (computer science) an electronic device that must be attached to a computer in order for it to use protected software

doubler.definition: an electronic device that doubles the voltage or the frequency of an input signal

generator (electronic_device).definition: an electronic device for producing a signal voltage

oscillator.definition: generator that produces sonic oscillations or alternating current

crystal_oscillator.definition: an oscillator that produces electrical oscillations at a frequency determined by the physical characteristics of a piezoelectric quartz crystal

local_oscillator.definition: an oscillator whose output heterodynes with the incoming radio signal to produce sum and difference tones

pulse_generator.definition: a generator of single or multiple voltage pulses; usually adjustable for pulse rate

pinger.definition: a pulse generator used for echo sounding in sonar

hearing_aid (electronic_device).definition: an electronic device that amplifies sound and is worn to compensate for poor hearing

logic_element.definition: an electronic device that performs an elementary logic operation

threshold_element.definition: a logic element that performs a threshold operation

mouse (electronic_device).definition: a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad

multiplexer.definition: a device that can interleave two or more activities

data_multiplexer.definition: a multiplexer that permits two or more data sources to share a common transmission medium

pacemaker.definition: an implanted electronic device that takes over the function of the natural cardiac pacemaker

personal_digital_assistant.definition: a lightweight consumer electronic device that looks like a hand-held computer but instead performs specific tasks; can serve as a diary or a personal database or a telephone or an alarm clock etc.

readout.definition: an electronic device the displays information is a visual form

repeater (electronic_device).definition: (electronics) electronic device that amplifies a signal before transmitting it again

system_clock (electronic_device).definition: an electronic device in a computer that issues a steady high-frequency signal that synchronizes all the internal components

trackball.definition: an electronic device consisting of a rotatable ball in a housing; used to position the cursor and move images on a computer screen

tube (electronic_device).definition: electronic device consisting of a system of electrodes arranged in an evacuated glass or metal envelope

acorn_tube.definition: a small vacuum tube; used at high frequencies

diode (tube).definition: a thermionic tube having two electrodes; used as a rectifier

electron_multiplier.definition: a vacuum tube that amplifies a flow of electrons

gas-discharge_tube.definition: a tube in which an electric discharge takes place through a gas

cathode-ray_tube.definition: a vacuum tube in which a hot cathode emits a beam of electrons that pass through a high voltage anode and are focused or deflected before hitting a phosphorescent screen

kinescope.definition: a cathode-ray tube in a television receiver; translates the received signal into a picture on a luminescent screen

color_tube.definition: a television tube that displays images in full color

tricolor_television_tube.definition: a color television tube in which three primary colors are combined to give the full range of colors

glow_lamp.definition: a gas-discharge tube with a hot cathode; used in stroboscopes

glow_tube.definition: a gas-discharge tube consisting of a cold cathode and a diode in a tube filled with gas; the color of the glow depends on the particular gas

klystron.definition: an electron tube used to generate or amplify electromagnetic radiation in the microwave region by velocity modulation

magnetron.definition: a diode vacuum tube in which the flow of electrons from a central cathode to a cylindrical anode is controlled by crossed magnetic and electric fields; used mainly in microwave oscillators

pentode.definition: a thermionic tube having five electrodes

television-camera_tube.definition: a tube that rapidly scans an optical image and converts it into electronic signals

iconoscope.definition: the first practical television-camera for picture pickup; invented in 1923 by Vladimir Kosma Zworykin

orthicon.definition: a now obsolete picture pickup tube in a television camera; electrons emitted from a photoemissive surface in proportion to the intensity of the incident light are focused onto the target causing secondary emission of electrons

tetrode.definition: a thermionic tube having four electrodes

triode.definition: a thermionic vacuum tube having three electrodes; fluctuations of the charge on the grid control the flow from cathode to anode which makes amplification possible

x-ray_tube.definition: a vacuum tube containing a metal target onto which a beam of electrons is directed at high energy for the generation of X rays

energizer (device).definition: a device that supplies electrical energy

exercise_device.definition: a device designed to provide exercise for the user

exercise_bike.definition: an exercise device resembling a stationary bike

treadmill (exercise_device).definition: an exercise device consisting of an endless belt on which a person can walk or jog without changing place

explosive_device.definition: device that bursts with sudden violence from internal energy

blasting_cap.definition: a small tube filled with detonating substances; used to detonate high explosives

percussion_cap.definition: a detonator that explodes when struck

improvised_explosive_device.definition: an explosive device that is improvised

molotov_cocktail.definition: a crude incendiary bomb made of a bottle filled with flammable liquid and fitted with a rag wick

petard.definition: an explosive device used to break down a gate or wall

shoe_bomb.definition: an explosive device concealed inside the heel and sole of a shoe

fan (device).definition: a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces

electric_fan.definition: a fan run by an electric motor

exhaust_fan.definition: a fan that moves air out of an enclosure

attic_fan.definition: a fan that blows heated air out of the attic of a building

punkah.definition: a large fan consisting of a frame covered with canvas that is suspended from the ceiling; used in India for circulating air in a room

filter (device).definition: device that removes something from whatever passes through it

filter_tip.definition: an air filter on the end of a cigarette; contains material that filters the smoke

bacteria_bed.definition: layer of sand or gravel used to expose sewage effluent to air and the action of microorganisms

coffee_filter.definition: filter (usually of paper) that passes the coffee and retains the coffee grounds

drain_basket.definition: a filter in a sink drain; traps debris but passes water

filter_bed.definition: filter consisting of a layer of sand or gravel for filtering water

fuel_filter.definition: a filter in the fuel line that screens out dirt and rust particles from the fuel

glass_wool.definition: glass fibers spun and massed into bundles resembling wool

light_filter.definition: a transparent filter that reduces the light (or some wavelengths of the light) passing through it

oil_filter.definition: a filter that removes impurities from the oil used to lubricate an internal-combustion engine

strainer.definition: a filter to retain larger pieces while smaller pieces and liquids pass through

colander.definition: bowl-shaped strainer; used to wash or drain foods

sieve.definition: a strainer for separating lumps from powdered material or grading particles

tea-strainer.definition: a device to keep back tea leaves when pouring a cup of tea

water_filter.definition: a filter to remove impurities from the water supply

fire_extinguisher.definition: a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires

flare.definition: a device that produces a bright light for warning or illumination or identification

fusee (flare).definition: a colored flare used as a warning signal by trucks and trains

fumigator (device).definition: a device that generates a gas for the purpose of disinfecting or eradicating pests

gas_fixture.definition: a device to convey illuminating gas from the pipe to the gas burner

groover.definition: a device that makes grooves by cutting or punching

guard (device).definition: a device designed to prevent injury or accidents

safety_catch.definition: guard consisting of a locking device that prevents a weapon from being fired

water_back.definition: water heater consisting of a tank or pipes set at the back of a fireplace or in the firebox of a stove

demister.definition: heater that removes mist from the windshield of a car

gas_heater.definition: a heater that burns gas for heat

heating_pad.definition: heater consisting of electrical heating elements contained in a flexible pad

oil_heater.definition: heater that burns oil (as kerosine) for heating or cooking

radiator (heater).definition: heater consisting of a series of pipes for circulating steam or hot water to heat rooms or buildings

solar_heater.definition: a heater that makes direct use of solar energy

space_heater.definition: heater consisting of a self-contained (usually portable) unit to warm a room

heat_lamp.definition: electric heater consisting of a high-power incandescent lamp that emits infrared radiation

chuck.definition: a holding device consisting of adjustable jaws that center a workpiece in a lathe or center a tool in a drill

collet (chuck).definition: a cone-shaped chuck used for holding cylindrical pieces in a lathe

clamp.definition: a device (generally used by carpenters) that holds things firmly together

bench_clamp.definition: a clamp used to hold work in place on a workbench

c-clamp.definition: a clamp in the shape of the letter C

cramp (clamp).definition: a clamp for holding pieces of wood together while they are glued

pipe_vise.definition: a clamp for holding pipe that is to be cut or threaded

press (clamp).definition: clamp to prevent wooden rackets from warping when not in use

candlestick.definition: a holder with sockets for candles

candelabrum.definition: branched candlestick; ornamental; has several lights

girandole.definition: an ornate candle holder; often with a mirror

keyboard (holder).definition: holder consisting of an arrangement of hooks on which keys or locks can be hung

peg (holder).definition: a holder attached to the gunwale of a boat that holds the oar in place and acts as a fulcrum for rowing

zarf.definition: an ornamental metal cup-shaped holder for a hot coffee cup

jaw.definition: holding device consisting of one or both of the opposing parts of a tool that close to hold an object

last.definition: holding device shaped like a human foot that is used to fashion or repair shoes

pullback.definition: a device (as a decorative loop of cord or fabric) for holding or drawing something back

spike (holding_device).definition: any holding device consisting of a rigid, sharp-pointed object

vise.definition: a holding device attached to a workbench; has two jaws to hold workpiece firmly in place

wood_vise.definition: a vise with jaws that are padded in order to hold lumber without denting it

horn (device).definition: a device having the shape of a horn

imprint.definition: a device produced by pressure on a surface

indicator.definition: a device for showing the operating condition of some system

annunciator.definition: an indicator that announces which electrical circuit has been active (as on a telephone switchboard)

cursor.definition: (computer science) indicator consisting of a movable spot of light (an icon) on a visual display; moving it allows the user to point to commands or screen positions

dial (indicator).definition: the circular graduated indicator on various measuring instruments

fuel_gauge.definition: an indicator of the amount of fuel remaining in a vehicle

pointer (indicator).definition: an indicator as on a dial

scale (indicator).definition: an indicator having a graduated sequence of marks

vernier_scale.definition: a small movable scale that slides along a main scale; the small scale is calibrated to indicate fractional divisions of the main scale

test_paper.definition: paper impregnated with an indicator for use in chemical tests

tidemark.definition: indicator consisting of a line at the highwater or low-water limits of the tides

instrument (device).definition: a device that requires skill for proper use

cryocautery.definition: an instrument for destroying tissue by freezing it

searing_iron.definition: a hot iron used to destroy tissue

divider (drafting_instrument).definition: a drafting instrument resembling a compass that is used for dividing lines into equal segments or for transferring measurements

protractor.definition: drafting instrument used to draw or measure angles

extractor.definition: an instrument for extracting tight-fitting components

forceps.definition: an extractor consisting of a pair of pincers used in medical treatment (especially for the delivery of babies)

cucking_stool.definition: an instrument of punishment consisting of a chair in which offenders were ducked in water

thumbscrew (instrument_of_torture).definition: instrument of torture that crushes the thumb

paddle (instrument_of_punishment).definition: an instrument of punishment consisting of a flat board

pillory.definition: a wooden instrument of punishment on a post with holes for the wrists and neck; offenders were locked in and so exposed to public scorn

stocks.definition: a former instrument of punishment consisting of a heavy timber frame with holes in which the feet (and sometimes the hands) of an offender could be locked

switch (instrument_of_punishment).definition: a flexible implement used as an instrument of punishment

birch (switch).definition: a switch consisting of a twig or a bundle of twigs from a birch tree; used to hit people as punishment

cane (switch).definition: a stiff switch used to hit students as punishment

ferule.definition: a switch (a stick or cane or flat paddle) used to punish children

rattan (switch).definition: a switch made from the stems of the rattan palms

measuring_instrument.definition: instrument that shows the extent or amount or quantity or degree of something

accelerometer.definition: an instrument for measuring the acceleration of aircraft or rockets

actinometer.definition: an instrument for measuring the intensity of electromagnetic radiation (usually by the photochemical effect)

algometer.definition: device for measuring pain caused by pressure

altazimuth.definition: an instrument that measures the altitude and azimuth of celestial bodies; used in navigation

altimeter.definition: an instrument that measures the height above ground; used in navigation

hypsometer.definition: an altimeter that uses the boiling point of water to determine land elevation

atmometer.definition: an instrument that measures rate of evaporation of water

audiometer.definition: an instrument used to measure the sensitivity of hearing

barometer.definition: an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure

barograph.definition: a recording barometer; automatically records on paper the variations in atmospheric pressure

mercury_barometer.definition: barometer that shows pressure by the height of a column of mercury

weatherglass.definition: a simple barometer for indicating changes in atmospheric pressure

bathymeter.definition: an instrument that measures the depth of water

bolometer.definition: an instrument that measures heat radiation; extremely sensitive

burette.definition: measuring instrument consisting of a graduated glass tube with a tap at the bottom; used for titration

caliper.definition: an instrument for measuring the distance between two points (often used in the plural)

inside_caliper.definition: caliper for measuring inside dimensions (the size of a cavity or hole); points on its legs curve outward

odd-leg_caliper.definition: caliper having the points on its legs both curve in the same direction

outside_caliper.definition: caliper for measuring outside dimensions; points on its legs curve inward

vernier_caliper.definition: a caliper with a vernier scale for very fine measurements

calorimeter.definition: a measuring instrument that determines quantities of heat

bomb_calorimeter.definition: strong sealed vessel for measuring heat of combustion

chronoscope.definition: an instrument for accurate measurements of small intervals of time

time-delay_measuring_instrument.definition: chronoscope for measuring the time difference between two events

colorimeter.definition: a measuring instrument used in colorimetric analysis to determine the quantity of a substance from the color it yields with specific reagents

counter_tube.definition: a measuring instrument for counting individual ionizing events

crystal_counter.definition: a counter tube in which an ionizing event increases conductivity

geiger_counter.definition: counter tube that detects ionizing radiations

proportional_counter_tube.definition: counter tube whose output pulse is proportional to number of ions produced

boron_counter_tube.definition: a proportional counter tube for counting neutrons

scintillation_counter.definition: counter tube in which light flashes when exposed to ionizing radiation

craniometer.definition: an instrument for measuring skull sizes

cryoscope.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring freezing and melting points

declinometer.definition: an instrument for measuring magnetic declination

densimeter.definition: a measuring instrument for determining density or specific gravity

dasymeter.definition: densimeter consisting of a thin glass globe that is weighed in a gas to determine its density

densitometer.definition: a measuring instrument for determining optical or photographic density

microphotometer.definition: special kind of densitometer that measures density variations over a very small area

dosemeter.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring doses of ionizing radiation (X-rays or radioactivity)

dynamometer.definition: measuring instrument designed to measure power

electrodynamometer.definition: measuring instrument that uses the interaction of the magnetic fields of two coils to measure current or voltage or power

electroscope.definition: measuring instrument that detects electric charge; two gold leaves diverge owing to repulsion of charges with like sign

eudiometer.definition: measuring instrument consisting of a graduated glass tube for measuring volume changes in chemical reactions between gases

gauge.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring and indicating a quantity such as the thickness of wire or the amount of rain etc.

anemometer.definition: a gauge for recording the speed and direction of wind

depth_gauge.definition: a gauge for measuring the depth of grooves or holes or other concavities

dipstick.definition: a graduated rod dipped into a container to indicate the fluid level

gasoline_gauge.definition: gauge that indicates the amount of gasoline left in the gasoline tank of a vehicle

pressure_gauge.definition: gauge for measuring and indicating fluid pressure

manometer.definition: a pressure gauge for comparing pressures of a gas

tensimeter.definition: a manometer for measuring vapor pressure

sphygmomanometer.definition: a pressure gauge for measuring blood pressure

rain_gauge.definition: gauge consisting of an instrument to measure the quantity of precipitation

strain_gauge.definition: a gauge for measuring strain in a surface

surface_gauge.definition: gauge consisting of a scriber mounted on an adjustable stand; used to test the accuracy of plane surfaces

vacuum_gauge.definition: a gauge for indicating negative atmospheric pressure

water_gauge.definition: gauge for indicating the level of water in e.g. a tank or boiler or reservoir

water_level.definition: a water gauge that shows the level by showing the surface of the water in a trough or U-shaped tube

wire_gauge.definition: gauge for measuring the diameter of wire

graduate.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring fluid volume; a glass container (cup or cylinder or flask) whose sides are marked with or divided into amounts

gravimeter.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring variations in the gravitational field of the earth

heliometer.definition: an instrument used to measure the angular separation of two stars that are too far apart to be included in the field of view of an ordinary telescope

hydrometer.definition: a measuring instrument for determining the specific gravity of a liquid or solid

salinometer.definition: a hydrometer that determines the concentration of salt solutions by measuring their density

hygrodeik.definition: a wet and dry bulb hygrometer

integrator.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring the area of an irregular plane figure

interferometer.definition: any measuring instrument that uses interference patterns to make accurate measurements of waves

ionization_chamber.definition: a measuring instrument that measures the amount of ionizing radiation

boron_chamber.definition: an ionization chamber lined with boron or filled with boron trifluoride gas for counting low velocity neutrons

geiger_tube.definition: an ionization chamber contained in a tube in a Geiger counter

kundt's_tube.definition: a measuring instrument used to measure the speed of sound

log.definition: measuring instrument that consists of a float that trails from a ship by a knotted line in order to measure the ship's speed through the water

harpoon_log.definition: a cylindrical log with a device that registers distance

patent_log.definition: a cigar-shaped log with rotary fins that measure the ship's speed

measuring_stick.definition: measuring instrument having a sequence of marks at regular intervals; used as a reference in making measurements

board_rule.definition: a measure used in computing board feet

rule.definition: measuring stick consisting of a strip of wood or metal or plastic with a straight edge that is used for drawing straight lines and measuring lengths

carpenter's_rule.definition: a rule used by a carpenter

meterstick.definition: a rule one meter long (usually marked off in centimeters and millimeters)

yardstick.definition: a ruler or tape that is three feet long

size_stick.definition: a mechanical measuring stick used by shoe fitters to measure the length and width of your foot

meter.definition: any of various measuring instruments for measuring a quantity

milliammeter.definition: a sensitive ammeter graduated in milliamperes

electric_meter.definition: a meter for measuring the amount of electric power used

electrometer.definition: meter to measure electrostatic voltage differences; draws no current from the source

fluxmeter.definition: meter that measures magnetic flux by the current it generates in a coil

ballistic_galvanometer.definition: a moving-coil galvanometer that measures electric charge

gas_meter.definition: a meter for measuring the amount of gas flowing through a particular pipe

magnetometer.definition: a meter to compare strengths of magnetic fields

odometer.definition: a meter that shows mileage traversed

water_meter.definition: meter for measuring the quantity of water passing through a particular outlet
