cortinarius_armillatus.definition: a fungus with large tawny caps and pale cinnamon gills and a red band of veil around the stalk; usually found near birch trees

cortinarius_atkinsonianus.definition: an edible fungus with a slimy viscid cap that is initially yellow but turns olive and then tawny; flesh is lavender

cortinarius_corrugatus.definition: a fungus with a viscid wrinkled tawny cap; the stalk has a basal bulb that diminishes as the stalk elongates; the gills are dark violet at first but soon turn brown

cortinarius_gentilis.definition: a poisonous fungus with a bright yellow brown cap and a long cinnamon colored stalk

cortinarius_mutabilis.definition: a fungus with a reddish purple cap having a smooth slimy surface; close violet gills; all parts stain dark purple when bruised

cortinarius_semisanguineus.definition: a fungus with a dry brown cap and rusty red gills and a yellowish stalk

cortinarius_subfoetidus.definition: a fungus with a sticky lavender cap and stalk that whitish above and covered with a silky lavender sheath

cortinarius_violaceus.definition: a fungus that is violet overall with a squamulose cap

death_cap.definition: extremely poisonous usually white fungus with a prominent cup-shaped base; differs from edible Agaricus only in its white gills

deer_mushroom.definition: a small edible agaric with a slender stalk; usually found on rotting hardwoods

entoloma_aprile.definition: an agaric with a dark brown conical cap; fruits in early spring

entoloma_lividum.definition: a deadly poisonous agaric; a large cap that is first white (livid or lead-colored) and then turns yellowish or tan

fairy-ring_mushroom.definition: mushroom that grows in a fairy ring

false_deathcap.definition: agaric often confused with the death cup

floccose_chanterelle.definition: a mildly poisonous fungus with a fruiting body shaped like a hollow trumpet

fly_agaric.definition: poisonous (but rarely fatal) woodland fungus having a scarlet cap with white warts and white gills

gymnopilus_spectabilis.definition: a fungus with a brownish orange fruiting body and a ring near the top of the stalk; the taste is bitter and the flesh contains psilocybin and psilocin

gymnopilus_validipes.definition: a poisonous fungus with a dry cap and a cortina that does not leave much of a ring on the robust stalk

gymnopilus_ventricosus.definition: a giant fungus of the Pacific Northwest; has a very thick stalk and the cortina leaves a ring high up on the stalk

honey_mushroom.definition: a honey-colored edible mushroom commonly associated with the roots of trees in late summer and fall; do not eat raw

horse_mushroom.definition: coarse edible mushroom with a hollow stem and a broad white cap

inky_cap.definition: having a cap that melts into an inky fluid after spores have matured

jack-o-lantern_fungus.definition: a large poisonous agaric with orange caps and narrow clustered stalks; the gills are luminescent

lepiota.definition: any fungus of the genus Lepiota

american_parasol.definition: an agaric with a pallid cap and a stalk that is enlarged near the base

lepiota_clypeolaria.definition: an agaric with a ragged stalk and a soft floccose cap

lepiota_naucina.definition: an agaric with greyish white fruiting body and gills that change from pink to dingy red

lepiota_rhacodes.definition: an agaric with a large cap with brown scales and a thick stalk

lepiota_rubrotincta.definition: an agaric with a relatively small pink to red cap and white gills and stalk

onion_stem.definition: a white agaric that tends to cluster and has a club-shaped base

man-on-a-horse.definition: an edible agaric with yellow gills and a viscid yellow cap that has a brownish center

meadow_mushroom.definition: common edible mushroom found naturally in moist open soil; the cultivated mushroom of commerce

nameko.definition: one of the most important fungi cultivated in Japan

oyster_mushroom.definition: edible agaric with a soft greyish cap growing in shelving masses on dead wood

parasol_mushroom.definition: edible long-stalked mushroom with white flesh and gills and spores; found in open woodlands in autumn

pholiota_astragalina.definition: a fungus with a smooth orange cap and yellow gills and pale yellow stalk

pholiota_aurea.definition: a beautiful yellow gilled fungus found from Alaska south along the coast

pholiota_destruens.definition: a large fungus with whitish scales on the cap and remnants of the veil hanging from the cap; the stalk is thick and hard

pholiota_flammans.definition: a fungus with a yellow cap covered with fine scales as is the stalk

pholiota_flavida.definition: a fungus that grows in clusters on the ground; cap is brownish orange with a surface that is smooth and slightly sticky; whitish gills and a cylindrical brown stalk

pholiota_squarrosa-adiposa.definition: a gilled fungus having yellow slimy caps with conspicuous tawny scales on the caps and stalks

pholiota_squarrosa.definition: a gilled fungus with a cap and stalk that are conspicuously scaly with upright scales; gills develop a greenish tinge with age

pholiota_squarrosoides.definition: a pale buff fungus with tawny scales

pig's_ears.definition: an edible agaric with a brown fruiting body that is often compound

pluteus_aurantiorugosus.definition: an agaric with a brilliant scarlet cap and a slender stalk

pluteus_magnus.definition: an edible agaric found in piles of hardwood sawdust; the caps are black and coarsely wrinkled

royal_agaric.definition: widely distributed edible mushroom resembling the fly agaric

sandy_mushroom.definition: an edible agaric that fruits in great clusters (especially in sandy soil under cottonwood trees)

shaggymane.definition: common edible mushroom having an elongated shaggy white cap and black spores

shoestring_fungus.definition: any of several fungi of the genus Armillaria that form brown stringy rhizomorphs and cause destructive rot of the roots of some trees such as apples or maples

straw_mushroom.definition: small tropical and subtropical edible mushroom having a white cap and long stem; an expensive delicacy in China and other Asian countries where it is grown commercially

stropharia_ambigua.definition: a gilled fungus with a long stalk and a yellow slimy cap from which fragments of the broken veil hang; gills are initially white but become dark brown as spores are released

stropharia_hornemannii.definition: a gilled fungus with a large slimy purple or olive cap; gills become purple with age; the stalk is long and richly decorated with pieces of the white sheath that extends up to a ring

stropharia_rugoso-annulata.definition: a large gilled fungus with a broad cap and a long stalk; the cap is dark brown; the white gills turn dark purplish brown with age; edible and choice

toadstool.definition: common name for an inedible or poisonous agaric (contrasting with the edible mushroom)

tricholoma_aurantium.definition: an orange tan agaric whose gills become brown by maturity; has a strong odor and taste

tricholoma_pardinum.definition: a poisonous agaric having a pale cap with fine grey fibrils

tricholoma_pessundatum.definition: a mildly poisonous agaric with a viscid reddish brown cap and white gills and stalk

tricholoma_sejunctum.definition: an agaric with a cap that is coated with dark fibrils in the center and has yellowish margins

tricholoma_vaccinum.definition: an agaric with a cap that is densely covered with reddish fibrils and pale gills and stalk

volvariella_bombycina.definition: a mushroom with a dry yellowish to white fibrillose cap

waxycap.definition: any fungus of the family Hygrophoraceae having gills that are more or less waxy in appearance

hygrocybe_acutoconica.definition: a fungus having an acutely conic cap and dry stalks

hygrophorus_borealis.definition: a fungus with a white convex cap and arcuate white gills and a stalk that tapers toward the base

hygrophorus_caeruleus.definition: a fungus with a broadly convex cap that is cream color with a tint of blue over the margin; waxy gills are bluish green to blue-grey; a short stalk tapers abruptly at the base

hygrophorus_inocybiformis.definition: a fungus with a drab squamulose cap and grey-brown squamules over the white background of the stalk and waxy grey-white gills

hygrophorus_kauffmanii.definition: a fungus with a slightly viscid cap; cap and gills are reddish brown and the stalk is grey

hygrophorus_marzuolus.definition: a grey fungus frequently found near melting snow banks

hygrophorus_purpurascens.definition: a fungus with a viscid purplish red cap and stalk; found under spruce and other conifers

hygrophorus_russula.definition: an edible fungus with a reddish cap and close pale gills and dry stalk; found under hardwoods

hygrophorus_sordidus.definition: an edible fungus with a large white cap and a dry stalk and white gills

hygrophorus_tennesseensis.definition: a fungus having a brownish sticky cap with a white margin and white gills and an odor of raw potatoes

hygrophorus_turundus.definition: a small fungus with orange cap and yellow gills found in sphagnum bogs

hygrotrama_foetens.definition: a small grey-brown fungus with an unpleasant odor of mothballs

neohygrophorus_angelesianus.definition: a fungus with a small brown convex cap with a depressed disc; waxy wine-colored gills and a brown stalk; fruits in or near melting snow banks in the western mountains of North America

winter_mushroom.definition: an edible agaric that is available in early spring or late fall when few other mushrooms are; has a viscid smooth orange to brown cap and a velvety stalk that turns black in maturity and pallid gills; often occur in clusters

mushroom.definition: any of various fleshy fungi of the subdivision Basidiomycota consisting of a cap at the end of a stem arising from an underground mycelium

morel.definition: any of various edible mushrooms of the genus Morchella having a brownish spongelike cap

black_morel.definition: a morel whose pitted fertile body is attached to the stalk with little free skirt around it; the fertile body is grey when young and black in old age

common_morel.definition: an edible and choice morel with a globular to elongate head with an irregular pattern of pits and ridges

disciotis_venosa.definition: an edible morel with a cup-shaped or saucer-shaped fruiting body can be up to 20 cm wide; the fertile surface inside the cup has wrinkles radiating from the center; can be easily confused with inedible mushrooms

morchella_crassipes.definition: a delicious morel with a conic fertile portion having deep and irregular pits

morchella_semilibera.definition: a morel with the ridged and pitted fertile portion attached to the stipe for about half its length

verpa.definition: a morel whose fertile portion resembles a bell and is attached to the stipe only at the top

verpa_bohemica.definition: resembles a thimble on a finger; the surface of the fertile portion is folded into wrinkles that extend from the top down; fruiting begins in spring before the leaves are out on the trees

verpa_conica.definition: a morel with a fertile portion that has a relatively smooth surface; the stalk is fragile

polypore.definition: woody pore fungi; any fungus of the family Polyporaceae or family Boletaceae having the spore-bearing surface within tubes or pores; the fruiting bodies are usually woody at maturity and persistent

albatrellus_dispansus.definition: a rare fungus having a large (up to 14 inches wide) yellow fruiting body with multiple individual caps and a broad central stalk and a fragrant odor

albatrellus_ovinus.definition: a fungus with a whitish often circular cap and a white pore surface and small pores and a white central stalk; found under conifers; edible but not popular

beefsteak_fungus.definition: a popular edible fungus with a cap the color of liver or raw meat; abundant in southeastern United States

bracket_fungus.definition: a woody fungus that forms shelflike sporophores on tree trunks and wood structures

neolentinus_ponderosus.definition: a gilled polypore with a large cap (up to 15 inches in diameter) and a broad stalk; edible when young and tender

nigroporus_vinosus.definition: a woody pore fungus with a dark brown to red brown cap and spore surface and small pores

oligoporus_leucospongia.definition: a pore fungus with a whitish cottony soft cap found on conifer logs in forests at high elevation in the western United States and adjacent Canada

polyporus_squamosus.definition: a fungus with a lateral stalk (when there is a stalk) and a scaly cap that becomes nearly black in maturity; widely distributed in the northern hemisphere

polyporus_tenuiculus.definition: a fungus with a whitish kidney-shaped cap and elongated pores; causes white rot in dead hardwoods

bird's-nest_fungus.definition: any of various fungi of the family Nidulariaceae having a cup-shaped body containing several egg-shaped structure enclosing the spores

black_root_rot_fungus.definition: fungus causing black root rot in apples

blastomycete.definition: any of various yeastlike budding fungi of the genus Blastomyces; cause disease in humans and other animals

bolete.definition: any fungus of the family Boletaceae

boletellus_russellii.definition: a fungus with a long coarsely shaggy reticulate stalk and a rimose areolate cap surface

boletus_chrysenteron.definition: a fungus convex cap and a dingy yellow under surface and a dry stalk

boletus_edulis.definition: an edible and choice fungus; has a convex cap that is slightly viscid when fresh and moist but soon dries and a thick bulbous tan stalk

boletus_luridus.definition: a poisonous fungus with a dingy yellow cap and orange red undersurface and a cylindrical reticulate stalk

boletus_mirabilis.definition: a fungus that is edible when young and fresh; has a dark brown convex cap with a yellow to greenish under surface and reddish stalk

boletus_pallidus.definition: a fungus that has an off-white cap when it is young but later becomes dingy brown and a stalk of the same color; the under surface of the cap (the tubes) a pale greenish yellow

boletus_pulcherrimus.definition: a beautiful but poisonous bolete; has a brown cap with a scarlet pore surface and a thick reticulate stalk

boletus_pulverulentus.definition: an edible fungus with a broadly convex blackish brown cap and a pore surface that is yellow when young and darkens with age; stalk is thick and enlarges toward the base

boletus_roxanae.definition: a fungus with a rusty red cap and a white pore surface that becomes yellow with age and a pale yellow stalk

boletus_subvelutipes.definition: a fungus with a velvety stalk and usually a dingy brown cap; injured areas turn blue instantly

boletus_variipes.definition: an edible (but not choice) fungus found on soil under hardwoods; has a dry convex cap with whitish under surface and a reticulate stalk

boletus_zelleri.definition: an edible and choice fungus that has a brown cap with greenish yellow under surface and a stalk that become dull red with age

frost's_bolete.definition: a fungus with a red cap and a red coarsely reticulate stalk

fuscoboletinus_paluster.definition: an edible fungus with a pinkish purple cap and stalk and a pore surface that is yellow with large angular pores that become like gills in maturity

fuscoboletinus_serotinus.definition: an edible fungus with a broadly convex brown cap and a whitish pore surface and stalk

leccinum_fibrillosum.definition: an edible fungus with a dark reddish brown cap and a wide light tan stalk that expands toward the base

old-man-of-the-woods.definition: edible mild-tasting mushroom found in coniferous woodlands of eastern North America

phylloporus_boletinoides.definition: a fungus with a broadly convex brown cap and pores that extend part way down the stalk

suillus_albivelatus.definition: a short squat edible fungus with a reddish brown cap and white stalk; fruits under pines in the spring

bottom_rot_fungus.definition: fungus causing bottom rot in lettuce

brown_root_rot_fungus.definition: fungus causing brown root rot in plants of the pea and potato and cucumber families

candida.definition: any of the yeastlike imperfect fungi of the genus Candida

candida_albicans.definition: a parasitic fungus that can infect the mouth or the skin or the intestines or the vagina

clubroot_fungus.definition: a fungus resembling slime mold that causes swellings or distortions of the roots of cabbages and related plants

coffee_fungus.definition: fungus causing a disease in coffee and some other tropical plants

coral_fungus.definition: any of numerous fungi of the family Clavariaceae often brightly colored that grow in often intricately branched clusters like coral

dead-man's-fingers.definition: the fruiting bodies of the fungi of the genus Xylaria

earthball.definition: any of various fungi of the genus Scleroderma having hard-skinned subterranean fruiting bodies resembling truffles

scleroderma_bovista.definition: an earthball with a peridium that is firm dry and smooth when young but developing cracks when mature; pale orange-yellow when young and reddish brown at maturity

scleroderma_citrinum.definition: an earthball fungus that is a dingy brownish yellow and a dark purplish interior; the peridium is covered with a pattern of small warts

scleroderma_flavidium.definition: an earthball with a smooth upper surface that is at first buried in sand; the top of the fruiting body opens up to form segments like the ray of an umbel

earthstar.definition: any fungus of the family Geastraceae; in form suggesting a puffball whose outer peridium splits into the shape of a star

astreus_hygrometricus.definition: a common species of earthstar widely distributed in sandy soil; the gleba is a pale tan

astreus_pteridis.definition: the largest earthstar; the fruiting body can measure 15 cm across when the rays are expanded

geastrum_coronatum.definition: an earthstar with a bluish spore sac and a purplish brown gleba; at maturity the outer layer splits into rays that bend backward and elevate the spore sac

earthtongue.definition: any club-shaped fungus of the genus Geoglossum

ergot.definition: a fungus that infects various cereal plants forming compact black masses of branching filaments that replace many grains of the plant; source of medicinally important alkaloids and of lysergic acid

rye_ergot.definition: a sclerotium or hardened mass of mycelium

false_morel.definition: a fungus of the family Helvellaceae

discina.definition: any fungus of the genus Discina

discina_macrospora.definition: a discina with a flat or saucer-shaped fertile body that is brown on the upper surface; has a short stalk; not recommended for eating

helvella.definition: any fungus of the genus Helvella having the ascocarps stalked or pleated or often in folds

helvella_acetabulum.definition: a helvella with a cup-shaped fertile body having a brown interior; the stalk is creamy white and heavily ribbed

helvella_crispa.definition: a helvella with a saddle-shaped fertile part and creamy color; the stalk is fluted and pitted

helvella_sulcata.definition: a helvella with an irregularly convoluted cap that is dark brown when young and becomes dull grey with age; the lower surface of the cap is smooth and pale grey; the stalk is thick and deeply fluted

false_truffle.definition: any of various fungi of the family Rhizopogonaceae having subterranean fruiting bodies similar to the truffle

rhizopogon_idahoensis.definition: a large whitish Rhizopogon that becomes greyish brown in maturity

truncocolumella_citrina.definition: a fungus with a round yellow to orange fruiting body that is found on the surface of the ground or partially buried; has a distinctive sterile column extending into the spore-bearing tissue

felt_fungus.definition: fungus that frequently encircles twigs and branches of various trees especially citrus trees in southern United States

gasteromycete.definition: any fungus of the class Gasteromycetes

calostoma_cinnabarina.definition: a gasteromycete with a leathery stalk and a fruiting body this globose and has a red spore case

calostoma_lutescens.definition: a gasteromycete with a leathery stalk and a fruiting body that is globose and has a pale yellow spore case

calostoma_ravenelii.definition: a gasteromycete with a leathery stalk and a fruiting body with a thin gelatinous spore case and elliptical spores

gastroboletus_scabrosus.definition: a dingy yellow brown fungus with a rough stalk that superficially resembles a bolete

gastroboletus_turbinatus.definition: a fungus with a cap that can vary from red to dark brown; superficially resembles a bolete

gastrocybe_lateritia.definition: a species of Gastrocybe fungus that has a conic cap and a thin stalk; at first the stalk is upright but as it matures the stalk bends over and then downward; the cap then gelatinizes and a slimy mass containing the spores falls to the ground as the stalk collapses

green_smut_fungus.definition: fungus causing green smut in rice

gyromitra.definition: any fungus of the genus Gyromitra

gyromitra_californica.definition: a gyromitra with a brown puffed up fertile part and a thick fluted stalk; found under conifers in California

gyromitra_esculenta.definition: a poisonous gyromitra; the surface of the fertile body is smooth at first and becomes progressively undulating and wrinkled (but never truly pitted); color varies from dull yellow to brown

gyromitra_gigas.definition: a gyromitra with a large irregular stalk and fertile part that is yellow to brown and wrinkled; has early fruiting time

gyromitra_infula.definition: a poisonous fungus; saddle-shaped and dull yellow to brown fertile part is relatively even

gyromitra_sphaerospora.definition: a gyromitra with a brown puffed up fertile part and a rosy pink fluted stalk and smooth round spores; found on hardwood slash east of the Great Plains

hen-of-the-woods.definition: large greyish-brown edible fungus forming a mass of overlapping caps that somewhat resembles a hen at the base of trees

jelly_fungus.definition: any fungus of the order Tremellales or Auriculariales whose fruiting body is jellylike in consistency when fresh

jew's-ear.definition: widely distributed edible fungus shaped like a human ear and growing on decaying wood

snow_mushroom.definition: popular in China and Japan and Taiwan; gelatinous mushrooms; most are dried

tremella_foliacea.definition: a jelly fungus with a fruiting body 5-15 cm broad and gelatinous in consistency; resembles a bunch of leaf lettuce; mostly water and brownish in color

tremella_reticulata.definition: a jelly fungus with an erect whitish fruiting body and a highly variable shape (sometimes resembling coral fungi)

lichen.definition: any thallophytic plant of the division Lichenes; occur as crusty patches or bushy growths on tree trunks or rocks or bare ground etc.

ascolichen.definition: a lichen in which the fungus component is an ascomycete

basidiolichen.definition: a lichen in which the fungus component is a basidiomycete

beard_lichen.definition: greenish grey pendulous lichen growing on trees

crottle.definition: any of several lichens of the genus Parmelia from which reddish brown or purple dyes are made

horsehair_lichen.definition: any of several lichens of the genus Alectoria having a thallus consisting of filaments resembling hair

iceland_moss.definition: lichen with branched flattened partly erect thallus that grows in mountainous and Arctic regions; used as a medicine or food for humans and livestock; a source of glycerol

lecanora.definition: any lichen of the genus Lecanora; some used in dyeing; some used for food

archil.definition: any of various lecanoras that yield the dye archil

manna_lichen.definition: any of several Old World partially crustaceous or shrubby lecanoras that roll up and are blown about over African and Arabian deserts and used as food by people and animals

reindeer_moss.definition: an erect greyish branching lichen of Arctic and even some north temperate regions constituting the chief food for reindeer and caribou and sometimes being eaten by humans

roccella.definition: a source of the dye archil and of litmus

lorchel.definition: a large fungus of the family Helvellaceae

gyromitra_fastigiata.definition: a lorchel with deep brownish red fertile part and white stalk

macowanites_americanus.definition: a small fungus with a fragile cap that cracks to expose the white context and a white stalk that is practically enclosed by the cap

mildew.definition: a fungus that produces a superficial (usually white) growth on organic matter

downy_mildew.definition: any of various fungi of the family Peronosporaceae parasitic on e.g. grapes and potatoes and melons

blue_mold_fungus.definition: fungus causing a serious disease in tobacco plants characterized by bluish-grey mildew on undersides of leaves

onion_mildew.definition: fungus causing a downy mildew on onions

tobacco_mildew.definition: fungus causing a downy mildew on growing tobacco

powdery_mildew.definition: any of various fungi of the genus Erysiphe producing powdery conidia on the host surface

mold (fungus).definition: a fungus that produces a superficial growth on various kinds of damp or decaying organic matter

mucor.definition: any mold of the genus Mucor

rhizopus.definition: any of various rot causing fungi of the genus Rhizopus

bread_mold.definition: a mold of the genus Rhizopus

water_mold.definition: parasitic or saprobic organisms living chiefly in fresh water or moist soil

monilia.definition: any of the yeastlike imperfect fungi of the genus Monilia

phytophthora_citrophthora.definition: causes brown rot gummosis in citrus fruits

phytophthora_infestans.definition: fungus causing late blight in solanaceous plants especially tomatoes and potatoes

pink_disease_fungus.definition: fungus causing pink disease in citrus and coffee and rubber trees etc

pond-scum_parasite.definition: an aquatic fungus of genus Synchytriaceae that is parasitic on pond scum

potato_fungus.definition: fungus causing a disease in potatoes characterized by black scurfy spots on the tubers

potato_wart_fungus.definition: fungus causing potato wart disease in potato tubers

puffball.definition: any of various fungi of the family Lycoperdaceae whose round fruiting body discharges a cloud of spores when mature

giant_puffball.definition: huge edible puffball up to 2 feet diameter and 25 pounds in weight

pythium.definition: any fungus of the genus Pythium

damping_off_fungus.definition: fungus causing damping off disease in seedlings

radiigera_fuscogleba.definition: a fungus similar to an earthstar except that it does not open up; the spore mass is brown at maturity with a column of sterile tissue extending up into it

rhizoctinia.definition: any fungus now or formerly belonging to the form genus Rhizoctinia

rust.definition: any of various fungi causing rust disease in plants

apple_rust.definition: rust fungus causing rust spots on apples and pears etc

blister_rust.definition: fungus causing white pine blister rust and having a complex life cycle requiring a plant of genus Ribes as alternate host

sac_fungus.definition: any of various ascomycetous fungi in which the spores are formed in a sac or ascus

scaly_lentinus.definition: a fungus with a scaly cap and white flesh and a ring on the stalk (with scales below the ring); odor reminiscent of licorice

sclerotinia.definition: any fungus of the genus Sclerotinia; some causing brown rot diseases in plants

shiitake.definition: edible east Asian mushroom having a golden or dark brown to blackish cap and an inedible stipe

slime_mold.definition: a naked mass of protoplasm having characteristics of both plants and animals; sometimes classified as protoctists

cellular_slime_mold.definition: differing from true slime molds in being cellular and nucleate throughout the life cycle

dictostylium.definition: any slime mold of the genus Dictostylium

true_slime_mold.definition: a slime mold of the class Myxomycetes

smut.definition: any fungus of the order Ustilaginales

cornsmut.definition: a smut fungus attacking Indian corn

boil_smut.definition: a common smut attacking Indian corn causing greyish white swellings that rupture to expose a black spore mass

covered_smut.definition: a smut fungus causing a smut disease of grains in which the spore masses are covered or held together by the grain membranes

flag_smut_fungus.definition: a smut fungus causing a smut in cereals and other grasses that chiefly affects leaves and stems and is characterized chains of sori within the plant tissue that later rupture releasing black masses of spores

wheat_flag_smut.definition: fungus affecting leaves and stems of wheat

head_smut.definition: smut fungus attacking heads of corn or sorghum and causing a covered smut

loose_smut.definition: a smut fungus of the genus Ustilago causing a smut disease of grains in which the entire head is transformed into a dusty mass of spores

onion_smut.definition: smut fungus causing blackish blisters on scales and leaves of onions; especially destructive to seedlings

stalked_puffball (fungus).definition: mushroom of the genus Tulostoma that resembles a puffball

stinkhorn.definition: any of various ill-smelling brown-capped fungi of the order Phallales

common_stinkhorn.definition: a common fungus formerly used in preparing a salve for rheumatism

dog_stinkhorn.definition: a stinkhorn having a stalk without a cap; the slimy gleba is simply plastered on its surface near the apex where winged insects can find it

phallus_ravenelii.definition: this stinkhorn has a cap with a granulose surface at the apex and smells like decaying flesh

stinky_squid.definition: a stinkhorn of genus Pseudocolus; the fruiting body first resembles a small puffball that soon splits open to form a stalk with tapering arms that arch and taper to a common point

tooth_fungus.definition: a fungus of the family Hydnaceae

true_fungus.definition: any of numerous fungi of the division Eumycota

truffle.definition: any of various highly prized edible subterranean fungi of the genus Tuber; grow naturally in southwestern Europe

verticillium.definition: a fungus of the genus Verticillium

white_fungus.definition: a fungus that attacks living fish and tadpoles and spawn causing white fungus disease: a coating of white hyphae on especially peripheral parts (as fins)

white_rust.definition: fungus causing a disease characterized by a white powdery mass of conidia

wynnea_americana.definition: a fungus composed of several apothecia that look like elongated rabbit ears; the sterile surface is dark brown and warty; the fertile surface is smooth and pinkish orange

wynnea_sparassoides.definition: a fungus with a long solid stalk embedded in soil and a yellow-brown head shaped like a cauliflower

yeast.definition: any of various single-celled fungi that reproduce asexually by budding or division

baker's_yeast.definition: used as a leaven in baking and brewing

yellow_spot_fungus.definition: fungus causing yellow spot (a sugarcane disease in Australia)

haploid.definition: (genetics) an organism or cell having only one complete set of chromosomes

heteroploid.definition: (genetics) an organism or cell having a chromosome number that is not an even multiple of the haploid chromosome number for that species

heterotroph.definition: an organism that depends on complex organic substances for nutrition

host (organism).definition: an animal or plant that nourishes and supports a parasite; it does not benefit and is often harmed by the association

definitive_host.definition: the host in which the sexual reproduction of a parasite takes place

intermediate_host.definition: a host that is used by a parasite in the course of its life cycle

hybrid.definition: (genetics) an organism that is the offspring of genetically dissimilar parents or stock; especially offspring produced by breeding plants or animals of different varieties or breeds or species

dihybrid.definition: a hybrid produced by parents that differ only at two gene loci that have two alleles each

monohybrid.definition: a hybrid produced by crossing parents that are homozygous except for a single gene locus that has two alleles (as in Mendel's experiments with garden peas)

katharobe.definition: an organism that lives in an oxygenated medium lacking organic matter

mascot.definition: a person or animal that is adopted by a team or other group as a symbolic figure

bacteria.definition: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants

acidophil.definition: an organism that thrives in a relatively acid environment

bacteroid.definition: a rodlike bacterium (especially any of the rod-shaped or branched bacteria in the root nodules of nitrogen-fixing plants)

calymmatobacterium.definition: a genus of bacterial rods containing only the one species that causes granuloma inguinale

diplococcus.definition: Gram-positive bacteria usually occurring in pairs

pneumococcus.definition: bacterium causing pneumonia in mice and humans

francisella.definition: a genus of Gram-negative aerobic bacteria that occur as pathogens and parasite in many animals (including humans)

gonococcus.definition: the pus-producing bacterium that causes gonorrhea

legionella_pneumophilia.definition: the motile aerobic rod-shaped Gram-negative bacterium that thrives in central heating and air conditioning systems and can cause Legionnaires' disease

nitrobacterium.definition: any of the bacteria in the soil that take part in the nitrogen cycle; they oxidize ammonium compounds into nitrites or oxidize nitrites into nitrates

nitrate_bacterium.definition: any of the nitrobacteria that oxidize nitrites into nitrates

nitrite_bacterium.definition: any of the nitrobacteria that oxidize ammonia into nitrites

penicillin-resistant_bacteria.definition: bacteria that are unaffected by penicillin

probiotic.definition: a beneficial bacterium found in the intestinal tract of healthy mammals; often considered to be a plant

streptobacillus.definition: any of various rod-shaped Gram-negative bacteria

superbug (bacteria).definition: a strain of bacteria that is resistant to all antibiotics

intestinal_flora.definition: harmless microorganisms (as Escherichia coli) that inhabit the intestinal tract and are essential for its normal functioning

microbe.definition: a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use

monad.definition: (biology) a single-celled microorganism (especially a flagellate protozoan)

moneran.definition: organisms that typically reproduce by asexual budding or fission and whose nutritional mode is absorption or photosynthesis or chemosynthesis

eubacteria.definition: a large group of bacteria having rigid cell walls; motile types have flagella

clostridium_perfringens.definition: anaerobic Gram-positive rod bacterium that produces epsilon toxin; can be used as a bioweapon

actinomyces.definition: soil-inhabiting saprophytes and disease-producing plant and animal parasites

actinomycete.definition: any bacteria (some of which are pathogenic for humans and animals) belonging to the order Actinomycetales

streptomyces.definition: aerobic bacteria (some of which produce the antibiotic streptomycin)

potato_scab_bacteria.definition: cause of a potato disease characterized by brownish corky tissue

bacillus.definition: aerobic rod-shaped spore-producing bacterium; often occurring in chainlike formations; found primarily in soil

bacillus_anthracis.definition: a species of bacillus that causes anthrax in humans and in animals (cattle and swine and sheep and rabbits and mice and guinea pigs); can be used a bioweapon

bacillus_subtilis.definition: a species of bacillus found in soil and decomposing organic matter; some strains produce antibiotics

yersinia_pestis.definition: a bacillus bacterium that causes the plague; aerosolized bacteria can be used as a bioweapon

botulinus.definition: anaerobic bacterium producing botulin the toxin that causes botulism

chlamydia.definition: coccoid rickettsia infesting birds and mammals; cause infections of eyes and lungs and genitourinary tract

chlamydia_psittaci.definition: bacteria responsible for the sexually transmitted disease chlamydia

chlamydia_trachomatis.definition: bacteria responsible for the sexually transmitted diseases chlamydia and lymphogranuloma venereum

clostridium.definition: spindle-shaped bacterial cell especially one swollen at the center by an endospore

coccobacillus.definition: a bacterial cell intermediate in morphology between a coccus and a bacillus; a very short bacillus

brucella.definition: an aerobic Gram-negative coccobacillus that causes brucellosis; can be used as a bioweapon

coccus.definition: any spherical or nearly spherical bacteria

staphylococcus.definition: spherical Gram-positive parasitic bacteria that tend to form irregular colonies; some cause boils or septicemia or infections

corynebacterium.definition: any species of the genus Corynebacterium

corynebacterium_diphtheriae.definition: a species of bacterium that causes diphtheria

cyanobacteria.definition: predominantly photosynthetic prokaryotic organisms containing a blue pigment in addition to chlorophyll; occur singly or in colonies in diverse habitats; important as phytoplankton

nostoc.definition: found in moist places as rounded jellylike colonies

trichodesmium.definition: large colonial bacterium common in tropical open-ocean waters; important in carbon and nitrogen fixation

enteric_bacteria.definition: rod-shaped Gram-negative bacteria; most occur normally or pathogenically in intestines of humans and other animals

erwinia.definition: rod-shaped motile bacteria that attack plants

escherichia_coli.definition: a species of bacterium normally present in intestinal tract of humans and other animals; sometimes pathogenic; can be a threat to food safety

klebsiella.definition: a genus of nonmotile rod-shaped Gram-negative enterobacteria; some cause respiratory and other infections

salmonella.definition: rod-shaped Gram-negative enterobacteria; cause typhoid fever and food poisoning; can be used as a bioweapon

salmonella_enteritidis.definition: a form of salmonella that causes gastroenteritis in humans

salmonella_typhimurium.definition: a form of salmonella that causes food poisoning in humans

typhoid_bacillus.definition: a form of salmonella that causes typhoid fever

shigella.definition: rod-shaped Gram-negative enterobacteria; some are pathogenic for warm-blooded animals; can be used as a bioweapon

lactobacillus.definition: a Gram-positive rod-shaped bacterium that produces lactic acid (especially in milk)

acidophilus.definition: a bacterium that is used to make yogurt and to supplement probiotics

listeria.definition: any species of the genus Listeria

listeria_monocytogenes.definition: the type species of the genus Listeria; can cause meningitis, encephalitis, septicemia, endocarditis, abortion, abscesses, listeriosis

mycobacteria.definition: rod-shaped bacteria some saprophytic or causing diseases

mycoplasma.definition: any of a group of small parasitic bacteria that lack cell walls and can survive without oxygen; can cause pneumonia and urinary tract infection

pleuropneumonialike_organism.definition: a mycoplasma resistant to antibiotics that causes a kind of pneumonia in humans

myxobacteria.definition: bacteria that form colonies in self-produced slime; inhabit moist soils or decaying plant matter or animal waste

nitric_bacteria.definition: soil bacteria that convert nitrites to nitrates

nitrosobacteria.definition: soil bacteria that oxidize ammonia to nitrites

phototrophic_bacteria.definition: green and purple bacteria; energy for growth is derived from sunlight; carbon is derived from carbon dioxide or organic carbon

purple_bacteria.definition: free-living Gram-negative pink to purplish-brown bacteria containing bacteriochlorophyll

pseudomonad.definition: bacteria usually producing greenish fluorescent water-soluble pigment; some pathogenic for plants and animals

ring_rot_bacteria.definition: causes brown rot in tomatoes and potatoes and tobacco etc

rickettsia.definition: any of a group of very small rod-shaped bacteria that live in biting arthropods (as ticks and mites) and cause disease in vertebrate hosts; they cause typhus and other febrile diseases in human beings

spirochete.definition: parasitic or free-living bacteria; many pathogenic to humans and other animals

borrelia.definition: cause of e.g. European and African relapsing fever

borrelia_burgdorferi.definition: cause of Lyme disease; transmitted primarily by ticks of genus Ixodes

leptospira.definition: important pathogens causing Weil's disease or canicola fever

treponema.definition: spirochete that causes disease in humans (e.g. syphilis and yaws)

streptococcus.definition: spherical Gram-positive bacteria occurring in pairs or chains; cause e.g. scarlet fever and tonsillitis

thiobacillus.definition: small rod-shaped bacteria living in sewage or soil and oxidizing sulfur

thiobacteria.definition: any bacterium of the genus Thiobacillus

comma_bacillus.definition: comma-shaped bacteria that cause Asiatic cholera

vibrio_fetus.definition: bacteria that cause abortion in sheep

xanthomonad.definition: bacteria producing yellow non-water-soluble pigments; some pathogenic for plants

archaebacteria.definition: considered ancient life forms that evolved separately from bacteria and blue-green algae

halophile.definition: archaebacteria requiring a salt-rich environment for growth and survival

halobacteria.definition: halophiles in saline environments such as the Dead Sea or salt flats

methanogen.definition: archaebacteria found in anaerobic environments such as animal intestinal tracts or sediments or sewage and capable of producing methane; a source of natural gas

thermoacidophile.definition: archaebacteria that thrive in strongly acidic environments at high temperatures

pathogen.definition: any disease-producing agent (especially a virus or bacterium or other microorganism)

protist.definition: free-living or colonial organisms with diverse nutritional and reproductive modes

alga.definition: primitive chlorophyll-containing mainly aquatic eukaryotic organisms lacking true stems and roots and leaves

brown_algae.definition: algae having the chlorophyll masked by brown and yellow pigments

fucoid (brown_algae).definition: any of various algae of the family Fucaceae

gulfweed.definition: brown algae with rounded bladders forming dense floating masses in tropical Atlantic waters as in the Sargasso Sea

kelp.definition: large brown seaweeds having fluted leathery fronds

sea_tangle.definition: any of various kelps especially of the genus Laminaria

rockweed.definition: coarse brown seaweed growing on rocks exposed at low tide

fucus.definition: any member of the genus Fucus

serrated_wrack.definition: brown algae seaweed with serrated edges

chlorella.definition: any alga of the genus Chlorella

confervoid_algae.definition: algae resembling confervae especially in having branching filaments

cryptomonad.definition: common in fresh and salt water appearing along the shore as algal blooms

euglenoid.definition: marine and freshwater green or colorless flagellate organism

golden_algae.definition: algae having the pigments chlorophyll and carotene and xanthophyll

green_algae.definition: algae that are clear green in color; often growing on wet ricks or damp wood or the surface of stagnant water

sea_lettuce.definition: seaweed with edible translucent crinkly green fronds

spirogyra.definition: freshwater algae consisting of minute filaments containing spiral chlorophyll bands

stonewort.definition: any of various submerged aquatic algae of the genus Chara having nodes with whorled filamentlike branches; usually encrusted with calcium carbonate deposits

red_algae.definition: marine algae in which the chlorophyll is masked by a red or purplish pigment; source of agar and carrageenan

irish_moss.definition: dark purple edible seaweed of the Atlantic coasts of Europe and North America

sea_moss.definition: any of various red algae having graceful rose to purple fronds (e.g. dulse or carrageen)

seaweed.definition: plant growing in the sea, especially marine algae

arame.definition: an edible seaweed with a mild flavor

sea_wrack.definition: growth of marine vegetation especially of the large forms such as rockweeds and kelp

seagrass.definition: any of various seaweeds that grow underwater in shallow beds

wrack.definition: dried seaweed especially that cast ashore

yellow-green_algae.definition: any alga of the division Chrysophyta with its chlorophyll masked by yellow pigment

conferva.definition: any of various algae of the genus Tribonema; algae with branching filaments that form scum in still or stagnant fresh water

protozoan.definition: any of diverse minute acellular or unicellular organisms usually nonphotosynthetic

arcella.definition: an amoeba-like protozoan with a chitinous shell resembling an umbrella

ciliate.definition: a protozoan with a microscopic appendage extending from the surface of the cell

infusorian.definition: any member of the subclass Infusoria

paramecium.definition: any member of the genus Paramecium

stentor (ciliate).definition: any of several trumpet-shaped ciliate protozoans that are members of the genus Stentor

tetrahymena.definition: relative of the paramecium; often used in genetics research

vorticella.definition: any of various protozoa having a transparent goblet-shaped body with a retractile stalk

difflugia.definition: a protozoan with an ovoid shell of cemented sand grains

euglena.definition: minute single-celled green freshwater organism having a single flagella; often classed as algae

flagellate.definition: a usually nonphotosynthetic free-living protozoan with whiplike appendages; some are pathogens of humans and other animals

costia.definition: a flagellate that is the cause of the frequently fatal fish disease costiasis

dinoflagellate.definition: chiefly marine protozoa having two flagella; a chief constituent of plankton

peridinian.definition: flagellate with a thick test composed of plates

giardia.definition: a suspected cause of diarrhea in humans

hypermastigote.definition: flagellate symbiotic in the intestines of e.g. termites

trichomonad.definition: cause of trichomoniasis in women and cattle and birds

zoomastigote.definition: flagellate protozoan lacking photosynthesis and other plant-like characteristics

plantlike_flagellate.definition: unicellular organisms having many characteristics of typical algae

ameba.definition: naked freshwater or marine or parasitic protozoa that form temporary pseudopods for feeding and locomotion

endameba.definition: any ameba of the genus Endamoeba

endamoeba_histolytica.definition: the parasitic ameba that causes amebic dysentery in human beings

foram.definition: marine microorganism having a calcareous shell with openings where pseudopods protrude

globigerina.definition: marine protozoan having a rounded shell with spiny processes

nummulite.definition: large fossil protozoan of the Tertiary period

testacean.definition: any of various rhizopods of the order Testacea characterized by having a shell

sarcodinian.definition: protozoa that move and capture food by forming pseudopods

actinopod.definition: protozoa having stiff rodlike radiating pseudopods

heliozoan.definition: protozoa with spherical bodies and stiff radiating pseudopods

radiolarian.definition: protozoa with amoeba-like bodies and radiating filamentous pseudopods

coccidium.definition: parasitic on the digestive epithelium of vertebrates and higher invertebrates

gregarine.definition: vermiform protozoans parasitic in insects and other invertebrates

haemoproteid.definition: related to malaria parasite and having a phase in the viscera of various birds

haemosporidian.definition: minute protozoans parasitic at some stage of the life cycle in blood cells of vertebrates including many pathogens

haplosporidian.definition: parasite in invertebrates and lower vertebrates of no known economic importance

merozoite.definition: a cell that arises from the asexual division of a parent sporozoan during its life cycle

microsporidian.definition: parasite of arthropods and fishes that invade and destroy host cells

myxosporidian.definition: mostly parasitic in fishes and including various serious pathogens

piroplasm.definition: minute parasite of red blood cells of mammals transmitted by a tick and causing diseases of domestic animals

plasmodium.definition: parasitic protozoan of the genus Plasmodium that causes malaria in humans

sarcosporidian.definition: parasite of the muscles of vertebrates

sporozoite.definition: one of the minute active bodies into which sporozoans divide in one stage of their life cycle

trophozoite.definition: a sporozoan in the active feeding stage of its life cycle

virus.definition: (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein

animal_virus.definition: an animal pathogen that is a virus

adenovirus.definition: any of a group of viruses including those that in humans cause upper respiratory infections or infectious pinkeye

parainfluenza_virus.definition: a virus that causes upper respiratory infection (including the common cold and bronchiolitis); most often in children

alphavirus.definition: an arbovirus of the family Togaviridae that can cause a variety of encephalitis in horses

arenavirus.definition: animal viruses belonging to the family Arenaviridae

junin_virus.definition: the RNA virus that causes Argentine hemorrhagic fever; carried by rats and mice

lassa_virus.definition: the RNA virus that causes Lassa fever

lymphocytic_choriomeningitis_virus.definition: the RNA virus that causes lymphocytic choriomeningitis; infects mice and monkeys and dogs and guinea pigs and human beings

machupo_virus.definition: the RNA virus that causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever; carried by rats and mice

bunyavirus.definition: an animal virus belonging to the family Bunyaviridae; can be used as a bioweapon

filovirus.definition: animal viruses belonging to the family Filoviridae

ebola_virus.definition: a filovirus that causes Ebola hemorrhagic fever; carried by animals; can be used as a bioweapon

marburg_virus.definition: a filovirus that causes Marburg disease; carried by animals; can be used as a bioweapon

flavivirus.definition: animal viruses belonging to the family Flaviviridae

west_nile_virus.definition: the flavivirus that causes West Nile encephalitis

hepadnavirus.definition: a group of animal DNA viruses including viruses of ducks and woodchucks and squirrels and others as well as the virus causing hepatitis B in humans

herpes.definition: any of the animal viruses that cause painful blisters on the skin

cytomegalovirus.definition: any of a group of herpes viruses that enlarge epithelial cells and can cause birth defects; can affect humans with impaired immunological systems

epstein-barr_virus.definition: the herpes virus that causes infectious mononucleosis; associated with specific cancers in Africa and China

herpes_simplex.definition: a herpes virus that affects the skin and nervous system

herpes_simplex_1.definition: a herpes virus that causes oral herpes

herpes_simplex_2.definition: a herpes virus that can cause genital herpes

herpes_zoster.definition: a herpes virus that causes shingles

herpes_varicella_zoster.definition: a herpes virus that causes chickenpox and shingles

varicella_zoster_virus.definition: the member of the herpes virus family that is responsible for chickenpox

lyssavirus.definition: a neurotropic non-arbovirus of the family Rhabdoviridae that causes rabies

myxovirus.definition: any of a group of RNA viruses including those that cause influenza and mumps

orthomyxovirus.definition: a group of viruses including those causing influenza

paramyxovirus.definition: a group of viruses including those causing mumps and measles

respiratory_syncytial_virus.definition: a paramyxovirus that forms syncytia in tissue culture and that is responsible for severe respiratory diseases such as bronchiolitis and bronchial pneumonia (especially in children)

papovavirus.definition: any of a group of animal viruses associated with or causing papillomas or polyomas

human_papilloma_virus.definition: any of a group of papovaviruses associated with genital or oral carcinomas or a group associated with benign genital tumors

polyoma.definition: a virus the can initiate various kinds of tumors in mice

parvovirus.definition: any of a group of viruses containing DNA in an icosahedral protein shell and causing disease in dogs and cattle; not known to be associated with any human disease

picornavirus.definition: a group of single-strand RNA viruses with a protein coat

enterovirus.definition: any of a group of picornaviruses that infect the gastrointestinal tract and can spread to other areas (especially the nervous system)

coxsackievirus.definition: enterovirus causing a disease resembling poliomyelitis but without paralysis

echovirus.definition: any of a group of viruses associated with various diseases including viral meningitis and mild respiratory disorders and diarrhea in newborn infants

rhinovirus.definition: any of a group of picornaviruses that are responsible for many upper respiratory infections

poxvirus.definition: any of a group of viruses that can cause pox diseases in vertebrates

myxoma_virus.definition: a poxvirus closely related to smallpox virus; causes benign gelatinous tumors in humans

variola_virus.definition: the virus that causes smallpox in humans; can be used as a bioweapon

variola_major.definition: a type of smallpox virus that has a fatality rate of up to 25 percent

variola_minor.definition: a type of smallpox virus that has a fatality rate of about 1 percent

reovirus.definition: any of a group of non-arboviruses including the rotavirus causing infant enteritis

retrovirus.definition: any of a group of viruses that contain two single-strand linear RNA molecules per virion and reverse transcriptase (RNA to DNA); the virus transcribes its RNA into a cDNA provirus that is then incorporated into the host cell

human_immunodeficiency_virus.definition: the virus that causes acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS); it replicates in and kills the helper T cells

rhabdovirus.definition: any of a group of arboviruses including those causing rabies

vesiculovirus.definition: an animal virus that causes vesicular stomatitis

arbovirus.definition: a large heterogeneous group of RNA viruses divisible into groups on the basis of the virions; they have been recovered from arthropods, bats, and rodents; most are borne by arthropods; they are linked by the epidemiologic concept of transmission between vertebrate hosts by arthropod vectors (mosquitoes, ticks, sandflies, midges, etc.) that feed on blood; they can cause mild fevers, hepatitis, hemorrhagic fever, and encephalitis

arenaviridae.definition: a family of arborviruses carried by arthropods

bunyaviridae.definition: a large family of arboviruses that affect a wide range of hosts (mainly vertebrates and arthropods)

flaviviridae.definition: a family of arboviruses carried by arthropods

reoviridae.definition: a family of arboviruses carried by arthropods

rhabdoviridae.definition: a family of arborviruses carried by arthropods

togaviridae.definition: a family of arboviruses carried by arthropods

bacteriophage.definition: a virus that is parasitic (reproduces itself) in bacteria

coliphage.definition: a bacteriophage that infects the bacterium Escherichia coli

typhoid_bacteriophage.definition: a bacteriophage specific for the bacterium Salmonella typhi

plant_virus.definition: a plant pathogen that is a virus consisting of a single strand of RNA

onion_yellow-dwarf_virus.definition: the virus that produces stunting and yellowing of the leaves of onion plants

potato_yellow-dwarf_virus.definition: the virus that produces stunting and yellowing of the leaves of potato plants

tobacco_mosaic_virus.definition: the widely studied plant virus that causes tobacco mosaic; it was the first virus discovered (1892)

viroid.definition: the smallest of viruses; a plant virus with its RNA arranged in a circular chromosome without a protein coat

slow_virus.definition: a virus that remains dormant in the body for a long time before symptoms appear

tumor_virus.definition: a cell-free filtrate held to be a virus responsible for a specific neoplasm

wound_tumor_virus.definition: a tumor virus transmitted by leafhoppers

vector.definition: (genetics) a virus or other agent that is used to deliver DNA to a cell

cosmid.definition: (genetics) a large vector that is made from a bacteriophage and used to clone genes or gene fragments

mutant (organism).definition: (biology) an organism that has characteristics resulting from chromosomal alteration

freak.definition: a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed

leviathan.definition: the largest or most massive thing of its kind

myrmecophile.definition: an organism such as an insect that habitually shares the nest of a species of ant

nekton.definition: the aggregate of actively swimming animals in a body of water ranging from microscopic organisms to whales

nonvascular_organism.definition: organisms without vascular tissue: e.g. algae, lichens, fungi, mosses

bryophyte.definition: any of numerous plants of the division Bryophyta

liverwort.definition: any of numerous small green nonvascular plants of the class Hepaticopsida growing in wet places and resembling green seaweeds or leafy mosses

leafy_liverwort.definition: moss-like liverwort with tiny scalelike leaves; usually epiphytic

acrocarp.definition: a moss in which the main axis is terminated by the archegonium (and hence the capsule)

pleurocarp.definition: a moss having the archegonium or antheridium on a short side branch rather than the main stalk

sphagnum.definition: any of various pale or ashy mosses of the genus Sphagnum whose decomposed remains form peat

parasite.definition: an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host

flea.definition: any wingless bloodsucking parasitic insect noted for ability to leap

cat_flea.definition: flea that breeds chiefly on cats and dogs and rats

chigoe.definition: small tropical flea; the fertile female burrows under the skin of the host including humans

dog_flea.definition: flea that attacks dogs and cats

pulex_irritans.definition: the most common flea attacking humans

sticktight.definition: parasitic on especially the heads of chickens

endoparasite.definition: any of various parasites that live in the internal organs of animals (especially intestinal worms)

parasitic_plant.definition: plant living on another plant and obtaining organic nutriment from it

american_mistletoe (parasitic_plant).definition: small herb with scalelike leaves on reddish-brown stems and berrylike fruits; parasitic on spruce and larch trees

bastard_toadflax.definition: woody creeping parasite of western North America having numerous thick powdery leaves and panicles of small dull-white flowers

buckleya.definition: parasitic shrub of the eastern United States having opposite leaves and insignificant greenish flowers followed by oily dull green olivelike fruits

flame_tree.definition: a terrestrial evergreen shrub or small tree of western Australia having brilliant yellow-orange flowers; parasitic on roots of grasses

hemiparasite.definition: a parasitic plant that contains some chlorophyll and therefore is capable of photosynthesis

loranthaceae.definition: in some classification includes Viscaceae: parasitic or hemiparasitic shrublets or shrubs or small trees of tropical and temperate regions; attach to hosts by haustoria

american_mistletoe (mistletoe).definition: the traditional mistletoe of Christmas in America: grows on deciduous trees and can severely weaken the host plant

parasite_yew.definition: rare and endangered monoecious parasitic conifer of New Caledonia; parasitic on Falcatifolium taxoides

rabbitwood.definition: shrub of southeastern United States parasitic on roots of hemlocks having sparse spikes of greenish flowers and pulpy drupes

parent (organism).definition: an organism (plant or animal) from which younger ones are obtained

abator.definition: a person who abates a nuisance

abomination.definition: a person who is loathsome or disgusting

abstainer (person).definition: a person who refrains from drinking intoxicating beverages

achiever.definition: a person with a record of successes

first_lady (achiever).definition: the leading woman in an art or profession

great.definition: a person who has achieved distinction and honor in some field

highflier.definition: a person of great ability and ambition

natural.definition: someone regarded as certain to succeed

acquaintance.definition: a person with whom you are acquainted

bunkmate.definition: someone who occupies the same sleeping quarters as yourself

campmate.definition: someone who lives in the same camp you do

connection (acquaintance).definition: (usually plural) a person who is influential and to whom you are connected in some way (as by family or friendship)

end_man (acquaintance).definition: a man at one end of a row of people

homeboy (acquaintance).definition: a male friend from your neighborhood or hometown

messmate.definition: (nautical) an associate with whom you share meals in the same mess (as on a ship)

pickup (acquaintance).definition: a casual acquaintance; often made in hope of sexual relationships

schoolmate.definition: an acquaintance that you go to school with

acquirer.definition: a person who acquires something (usually permanently)

appropriator.definition: someone who takes for his or her own use (especially without permission)

kleptomaniac.definition: someone with an irrational urge to steal in the absence of an economic motive

poacher (appropriator).definition: someone who hunts or fishes illegally on the property of another

preemptor (appropriator).definition: someone who acquires land by preemption

addressee.definition: one to whom something is addressed

cricket-bat_willow.definition: Eurasian willow tree having greyish leaves and ascending branches

dwarf_grey_willow.definition: willow shrub of dry places in the eastern United States having long narrow leaves canescent beneath

dwarf_willow.definition: widely distributed boreal shrubby willow with partially underground creeping stems and bright green glossy leaves

grey_willow.definition: Eurasian shrubby willow with whitish tomentose twigs

hoary_willow.definition: North American shrub with whitish canescent leaves

osier (willow).definition: any of various willows having pliable twigs used in basketry and furniture

purple_willow.definition: Eurasian osier having reddish or purple twigs and bark rich in tannin

silver_willow.definition: North American willow with greyish silky pubescent leaves that usually blacken in drying

wisconsin_weeping_willow.definition: hybrid willow usually not strongly weeping in habit

winter's_bark (tree).definition: South American evergreen tree yielding winter's bark and a light soft wood similar to basswood

yellowwood.definition: any of various trees having yellowish wood or yielding a yellow extract

gymnospermous_yellowwood.definition: any of various gymnospermous trees having yellow wood

zebrawood.definition: any of various trees or shrubs having mottled or striped wood

connarus_guianensis.definition: tropical American and east African tree with strikingly marked hardwood used in cabinetwork

blue_false_indigo.definition: wild indigo of the eastern United States having racemes of blue flowers

indigo_broom.definition: much-branched erect herb with bright yellow flowers; distributed from Massachusetts to Florida

white_false_indigo.definition: erect or spreading herb having racemes of creamy white flowers; the eastern United States

wilding.definition: a wild uncultivated plant (especially a wild apple or crabapple tree)

alpine_gold.definition: low tufted plant having hairy stems each topped by a flower head with short narrow yellow rays; northwestern United States

arnica_montana.definition: herb of pasture and open woodland throughout most of Europe and western Asia having orange-yellow daisylike flower heads that when dried are used as a stimulant and to treat bruises and swellings

coneflower.definition: a wildflower of the genus Ratibida

dwarf_hulsea.definition: similar to but smaller than alpine hulsea

orange_daisy.definition: mat-forming herb of Turkestan with nearly double orange-yellow flowers

maryland_golden_aster.definition: perennial golden aster of southeastern United States

goldenbush (wildflower).definition: a plant of the genus Haplopappus

camphor_daisy.definition: annual of southern United States and Mexico having bristly leaves and pale yellow flowers

yellow_spiny_daisy.definition: slender perennial of western North America having weakly bristly leaves and yellow flower heads

goldenrod.definition: any of numerous chiefly summer-blooming and fall-blooming North American plants especially of the genus Solidago

blue_mountain_tea.definition: goldenrod of eastern America having aromatic leaves from which a medicinal tea is made

seaside_goldenrod.definition: vigorous showy goldenrod common along eastern coast and Gulf Coast of North America

silverrod.definition: plant of eastern North America having creamy white flowers

fall_dandelion.definition: fall-blooming European herb with a yellow flower; naturalized in the United States

heliopsis.definition: any North American shrubby perennial herb of the genus Heliopsis having large yellow daisylike flowers

hot-rock_penstemon.definition: stems in clumps with cream-colored flowers; found from Washington to Wyoming and southward to California and Utah

indian_paintbrush.definition: any of various plants of the genus Castilleja having dense spikes of hooded flowers with brightly colored bracts

desert_paintbrush.definition: most common paintbrush of western United States dry lands; having erect stems ending in dense spikes of bright orange to red flowers

giant_red_paintbrush.definition: wildflower of western North America having ragged clusters of crimson or scarlet flowers

sagebrush_buttercup.definition: small early-flowering buttercup with shiny yellow flowers of western North America
